questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt: WHICH OF THESE INVESTIGATIONS IS USED TO DIAGNOSE UNICORNUATE UTERUS?
questions.explanation:
Source note: The source PDF omits the numbered statements or table referenced by this question.

LAPAROSCOPY AND HYSTEROSALPINGOGRAM (HSG) CAN BE USED TO DIAGNOSE UNICORNUATE UTERUS.
IN THE UNICORNUATE UTERUS, THE FORMATION OF THE UTERUS AND FALLOPIAN TUBE OCCURS ENTIRELY FROM ONE
MULLERIAN DUCT DUE TO THE DEVELOPMENTAL ARREST OF OTHER MULLERIAN DUCT. WOMEN WITH A
UNICORNUATE UTERUS HAVE AN INCREASED INCIDENCE OF INFERTILITY, ENDOMETRIOSIS, AND DYSMENORRHEA.
EVALUATION:
- THE INITIAL EVALUATION IS THROUGH SONOGRAPHY. IT CAN ALSO HELP PICK UP IPSILATERAL RENAL AGENESIS,
WHICH IS SEEN IN 40% OF THE WOMEN WITH UNICORNUATE UTERUS.
- SALINE INFUSION SONOGRAPHY (SIS) IS ANOTHER MODALITY TO IDENTIFY MULLERIAN ANOMALIES. IT CAN BE
USED AS A SCREENING TOOL FOR CAVITY EVALUATION AS WELL.
- ON HYSTEROSALPINGOGRAPHY, THE ENDOMETRIAL CAVITY USUALLY ASSUMES A FUSIFORM (BANANA) SHAPE,
TAPERING AT THE APEX AND DRAINING INTO A SINGLE FALLOPIAN TUBE. THE UTERUS IS GENERALLY SHIFTED OFF
THE MIDLINE.
- INVASIVE MODALITIES SUCH AS HYSTEROSCOPY/LAPAROSCOPY ARE RESERVED FOR PATIENTS WITH COMPLICATED
MULLERIAN ANOMALIES OR IN PATIENTS PRESENTING WITH INFERTILITY TO ESTABLISH THE DIAGNOSIS.
- THESE DAYS, MR IMAGING IS USED TO CHARACTERIZE AND PRE-OPERATIVELY EVALUATE CASES THAT ARE
COMPLICATED.
THE IMAGE BELOW SHOWS A HYSTEROSALPINGOGRAM OF A UNICORNUATE UTERUS
6027
FALLOPOSCOPY IS THE INSPECTION OF THE FALLOPIAN TUBES THROUGH A MICRO-ENDOSCOPE. HYSTEROSCOPIC
FALLOSCOPY REVEALS THE TUBAL PATHOLOGY OF THE CORNUAL AND INTERSTITIAL END OF THE FALLOPIAN TUBE.

questions.prompt: WHICH OF THESE SYMPTOMS ARE SEEN IN ENDOMETRIOSIS?

THE SYMPTOMS OF ENDOMETRIOSIS INCLUDE 1, 2, 4. ENDOMETRIOSIS PRESENTS WITH UNEXPLAINED
INFERTILITY, DYSMENORRHEA, AND VAGINAL BLEEDING.
ENDOMETRIOSIS IS THE PRESENCE OF ENDOMETRIAL TISSUE (GLANDS AND STROMA) OUTSIDE THE UTERUS. IT IS
AN ESTROGEN-DEPENDENT DISEASE OF THE CHILDBEARING AGE GROUP. THE MOST COMMON SITE OF
OCCURRENCE IS THE OVARY FOLLOWED BY THE POUCH OF DOUGLAS.
KEY CLINICAL FEATURES OF ENDOMETRIOSIS INCLUDE:
- DYSMENORRHOEA
- LOWER ABDOMINAL PAIN
- INFERTILITY
- PAIN DURING URINATION OR DEFECATION,
- CONSTIPATION OR DIARRHEA
- IRREGULAR BLEEDING.
THE GOLD STANDARD INVESTIGATION FOR THE DIAGNOSIS OF ENDOMETRIOSIS IS A VISUAL INSPECTION BY
LAPAROSCOPY, PREFERABLY WITH HISTOLOGICAL CONFIRMATION.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt:
A FEMALE PATIENT HAVING FROTHY VAGINAL DISCHARGE WAS FOUND TO HAVE A STRAWBERRY CERVIX.
WHICH OF THESE IS THE DRUG OF CHOICE?
questions.explanation:
THE GIVEN CLINICAL SCENARIO OF FROTHY VAGINAL DISCHARGE AND STRAWBERRY CERVIX IS SUGGESTIVE OF
TRICHOMONIASIS AND METRONIDAZOLE IS THE DRUG OF CHOICE FOR THE TREATMENT.
TRICHOMONAS VAGINALIS IS ONE OF THE MOST COMMON CAUSES OF VAGINAL DISCHARGE. IT IS TRANSMITTED
BY SEXUAL INTERCOURSE, WITH AN INCUBATION PERIOD OF 4–21 DAYS. THE CLINICAL FEATURES INCLUDE
VAGINAL DISCHARGE WHICH IS PROFUSE, THIN, SLIGHTLY GREEN IN COLOUR, AND FROTHY. IT MAY BE ASSOCIATED
WITH VAGINAL IRRITATION, PRURITUS, DYSURIA, AND INCREASED FREQUENCY. CERVICAL INFLAMMATION WITH
PUNCTATE HEMORRHAGIC SPOTS KNOWN AS THE STRAWBERRY CERVIX IS TYPICALLY SEEN. MOTILE TRICHOMONADS
ARE SEEN ON WET MOUNT EXAMINATION.
THE BELOW IMAGE SHOWS THE STRAWBERRY CERVIX SEEN IN TRICHOMONIASIS.
6029
ADMINISTRATION OF METRONIDAZOLE 2 G ORALLY IN A SINGLE DOSE OR 500 MG 2 TIMES/DAY FOR 7 DAYS IS THE
STANDARD TREATMENT. IT SHOULD BE TAKEN AT NIGHT AND AFTER MEALS TO AVOID VOMITING. IF THIS TOO
CAUSES VOMITING, OR IN RESISTANT CASES AN ALTERNATE REGIMEN IS TO BE CONSIDERED. BOTH THE PARTNERS
NEED TO BE TREATED SIMULTANEOUSLY TO AVOID RECURRENCE.
THE ALTERNATIVE REGIMEN INCLUDES TINIDAZOLE 500 MG ORALLY TWICE A DAY FOR 7 DAYS OR SECNIDAZOLE IN
A SINGLE DOSE OF 1000 MG DAILY FOR 2 DAYS. THE USE OF TINIDAZOLE IS NOT RECOMMENDED DURING
PREGNANCY.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt:
ACCORDING TO IADPSG, WHAT IS THE CUT-OFF VALUE OF FASTING BLOOD GLUCOSE FOR THE DIAGNOSIS OF
GESTATIONAL DIABETES MELLITUS?
questions.explanation:
ACCORDING TO IADPSG, THE CUT-OFF VALUE OF FASTING BLOOD GLUCOSE FOR THE DIAGNOSIS OF GESTATIONAL
DIABETES MELLITUS (GDM) IS >92 MG/DL.
GESTATIONAL DIABETES MELLITUS (GDM) REFERS TO ANY DEGREE OF GLUCOSE INTOLERANCE HAVING ITS ONSET OR
FIRST RECOGNITION DURING PREGNANCY.
FOR IADPSG CRITERIA, AN ORAL GLUCOSE TOLERANCE TEST (OGTT) IS DONE IN THE FASTING STATE USING 75 G
OF GLUCOSE, AND GDM IS DIAGNOSED IF ANY ONE OF THE FOLLOWING CUT-OFFS IS MET I.E.
- FASTING: >92 MG/DL
- 1HOUR: >180 MG/DL
- 2 HR: >153 MG/DL
EARLIER, A TWO-STEP APPROACH WAS BEING USED TO DIAGNOSE GDM. IN THIS, THE FIRST STEP (SCREENING) IS
A 50-GRAM ONE-HOUR GLUCOSE CHALLENGE TEST (GCT). THE PATIENTS HAVING A POSITIVE RESULT OF
>140MG/DL, ARE CANDIDATES FOR THE OGTT. A 100-GRAM, THREE-HOUR OGTT IS THE DIAGNOSTIC
TEST FOR GDM. GDM IS DIAGNOSED IF TWO OR MORE VALUES ARE POSITIVE, AS FOLLOWS.
THIS HAS NOW BEEN REPLACED BY THE ONE-STEP APPROACH THAT OMITS THE SCREENING TEST AND SIMPLIFIES
DIAGNOSTIC TESTING BY PERFORMING ONLY A 75-GRAM, TWO-HOUR ORAL GTT.
SOME COMPLICATIONS OF GDM:
- MATERNAL
- HYPERTENSION, PREECLAMPSIA
- HYDRAMNIOS
- INCREASED OPERATIVE INTERVENTIONS
- FUTURE DEVELOPMENT OF DIABETES MELLITUS
- FETAL AND NEONATAL
- FETAL MACROSOMIA
- CONGENITAL ANOMALIES
- METABOLIC ABNORMALITIES SUCH AS HYPOCALCEMIA, HYPOMAGNESEMIA, HYPERBILIRUBINEMIA, AND
NEONATAL HYPOGLYCEMIA.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt:
A PRIMIGRAVIDA IN HER 10TH WEEK OF GESTATION PRESENTS WITH SPOTTING. UPON EXAMINATION, THE
UTERUS CORRESPONDS TO 12 WEEKS. TRANSVAGINAL ULTRASOUND WAS DONE AND IT IS PROVIDED BELOW.
WHAT IS YOUR DIAGNOSIS?
questions.explanation:
THE GIVEN CLINICAL SCENARIO OF A PRIMIGRAVIDA WITH SPOTTING AND AN ULTRASOUND SHOWING A
CHARACTERISTIC SNOWSTORM APPEARANCE (ANECHOIC CYSTIC SPACES) IS SUGGESTIVE OF A HYDATIDIFORM MOLE
(COMPLETE MOLE). IT REFERS TO AN ECHOGENIC UTERINE MASS THAT HAS NUMEROUS ANECHOIC CYSTIC SPACES.
HYDATIFORM MOLE BELONGS TO THE BENIGN GROUP OF GESTATIONAL TROPHOBLASTIC DISEASES (GTD). IT IS AN
ABNORMALITY IN CHORIONIC VILLI MAKING THEM PARTLY PROLIFERATIVE AND DEGENERATIVE, THEREBY RESULTING
IN THE FORMATION OF MULTIPLE SMALL CYSTS. BASED ON THE PORTION OF THE CHORIONIC VILLI INVOLVED, THEY
COULD BE COMPLETE (DIFFUSED) OR PARTIAL (FOCAL)
THE CLASSICAL CLINICAL FEATURES OF A COMPLETE MOLE ARE:
- ABNORMAL VAGINAL BLEEDING -MOST COMMON (90%)
- LOWER ABDOMINAL PAIN
- HYPEREMESIS GRAVIDARUM DUE TO INCREASED β-HCG
- FEATURES OF EARLY-ONSET PREECLAMPSIA
- UTERUS APPEARS LARGE FOR DATE
- ABSENT FETAL PARTS AND FHS
- EXPULSION OF VESICULAR TISSUES (GRAPE-LIKE VESICLES)
- THECA LUTEIN CYST OF OVARIES OF MORE THAN 6 CM
- HYPERTHYROIDISM (RARE)
- SERUM HCG > 100,000 MIU/ML
- USG - SNOWSTORM APPEARANCE
THE DEFINITIVE MANAGEMENT AFTER DIAGNOSIS IS SUCTION AND EVACUATION, AFTER MAKING THE CERVIX
FAVORABLE. FOLLOW-UP OF THE PATIENTS WITH SERIAL HCG VALUES IS CRUCIAL.
PROPHYLACTIC CHEMOTHERAPY CAN BE STARTED ON HIGH-RISK WOMEN (WHO PROGNOSTIC SCORE > 7)
WITH METHOTREXATE 1MG/KG/DAY INTRAMUSCULAR/INTRAVENOUS ON DAYS 1, 3, 5, AND 7. PATIENTS ARE ALSO
ADVISED TO NOT GET PREGNANT FOR AT LEAST A YEAR.
6031
OTHER OPTIONS:
OPTION A: BLIGHTED OVUM (SILENT MISCARRIAGE) OCCURS WHEN A FERTILIZED EGG IMPLANTS IN THE UTERUS
BUT DOESN'T DEVELOP INTO AN EMBRYO. IT IS A SONOGRAPHIC DIAGNOSIS WHERE THERE IS AN ABSENCE OF A
FETAL POLE IN A GESTATIONAL SAC WITH A DIAMETER OF 3 CM OR MORE.
OPTION B: MISSED ABORTION IS WHEN THE FETUS IS DEAD AND RETAINED INSIDE THE UTERUS FOR A VARIABLE
PERIOD. USG SHOWS AN EMPTY SAC EARLY IN THE PREGNANCY OR THE ABSENCE OF FETAL CARDIAC ACTIVITY AND
FETAL MOVEMENTS.
OPTION C: ECTOPIC PREGNANCY IS ONE IN WHICH THE FERTILIZED OVUM IS IMPLANTED AND DEVELOPS OUTSIDE
THE NORMAL ENDOMETRIAL CAVITY. THE MAJORITY OF ECTOPIC PREGNANCIES OCCUR IN THE FALLOPIAN TUBE, THE
AMPULLA BEING THE MOST COMMON SITE.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt:
A 62-YEAR-OLD PATIENT WITH A HISTORY OF DIABETES AND HYPERTENSION CAME WITH POST-MENOPAUSAL
BLEEDING. WHICH OF THESE YOU WILL DO TO EVALUATE THE CAUSE?
questions.explanation:
ENDOMETRIAL SAMPLING IS DONE TO EVALUATE A PATIENT PRESENTING WITH POSTMENOPAUSAL BLEEDING.
POSTMENOPAUSAL BLEEDING IS DEFINED AS ANY BLEEDING FROM THE GENITAL TRACT AFTER 12 MONTHS OF
MENOPAUSE IN A WOMAN NOT ON HORMONE REPLACEMENT. ANY VAGINAL BLEEDING OCCURRING AFTER 6
MONTHS OF AMENORRHEA IN A MENOPAUSAL WOMAN SHOULD ALSO BE CONSIDERED AS POSTMENOPAUSAL
BLEEDING AND INVESTIGATED. ALL POSTMENOPAUSAL WOMEN WITH UNEXPECTED UTERINE BLEEDING SHOULD
BE EVALUATED FOR ENDOMETRIAL MALIGNANCY SINCE AGE IS A SIGNIFICANT RISK FACTOR FOR THIS.
TRANSVAGINAL ULTRASOUND (TVS) IS A BETTER FIRST-LINE INVESTIGATION. SINCE TVS IS NOT INCLUDED IN THE
OPTIONS, ENDOMETRIAL SAMPLING IS THE NEXT BEST ANSWER.
ENDOMETRIAL SAMPLING IS INDICATED IF:
- THE ENDOMETRIAL THICKNESS IS >4 MM
- THE ENDOMETRIUM SHOWS DIFFUSE OR FOCAL INCREASED ECHOGENICITY (HETEROGENEITY)
- THE ENDOMETRIUM IS NOT ADEQUATELY VISUALIZED ON TRANSVAGINAL SONOGRAPHY
- THE WOMAN HAS PERSISTENT BLEEDING, AS IT CAN BE A SIGN OF ENDOMETRIAL CANCER EVEN WHEN THE
ENDOMETRIAL THICKNESS IS LESS THAN 4MM.
THE IMAGE BELOW GIVES A SUMMARY OF THE EVALUATION OF POSTMENOPAUSAL BLEEDING, AS PER THE
FOGSI GUIDELINES.
6032
OTHER OPTIONS:
OPTION A: PAP SMEAR SHOULD BE OFFERED TO ALL WOMEN ABOVE THE AGE OF 21 YEARS WHO ARE
SEXUALLY ACTIVE FOR AT LEAST 3 YEARS. COLPOSCOPIC EXAMINATION AND SELECTIVE BIOPSY ARE CONSIDERED IN
PATIENTS WITH ABNORMAL PAP SMEARS.
OPTION B: VISUAL INSPECTION WITH IODINE IS DONE WHERE THE FACILITIES FOR PAP SCREENING DO NOT EXIST.
THIS INVOLVES PAINTING THE CERVIX WITH LUGOL'S IODINE. IT IS USED TO DETECT ANY ABNORMAL CYTOLOGY IN
THE CERVIX AND VAGINA, SUCH AS IN CASES OF CARCINOMA CERVIX.
THE NORMAL VAGINAL AND CERVICAL EPITHELIUM CONTAINS GLYCOGEN, THEREFORE STAINS MAHOGANY
BROWN ON BEING PAINTED WITH LUGOL'S IODINE. THE ABNORMAL CELLS REMAIN UNSTAINED. THESE AREAS
NEED TO BE BIOPSIED AND SENT FOR HISTOPATHOLOGICAL EXAMINATION.
OPTION C: THE COLPOSCOPIC STUDY IS CHALLENGING IN POSTMENOPAUSAL WOMEN BECAUSE OF NARROW
VAGINAS, SENILE VAGINITIS, INDRAWN AND POORLY VISIBLE SQUAMOCOLUMNAR JUNCTION, AND ATROPHIC
CERVIX.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt:
WHICH OF THESE IS RECOMMENDED BY THE WHO FOR THE MANAGEMENT OF THE SECOND STAGE
OF LABOR?
options: MANUAL PERINEAL SUPPORT AND WARM COMPRESSES
MAINTAIN HEAD IN DEFLEXION AND DELIVER
questions.answer: MANUAL PERINEAL SUPPORT AND WARM COMPRESSES
questions.explanation:
AMONG THE GIVEN OPTIONS, MANUAL PERINEAL SUPPORT AND GIVING WARM COMPRESSES ARE
RECOMMENDED BY WHO IN THE MANAGEMENT OF THE SECOND STAGE OF LABOR.
THE SECOND STAGE OF LABOR REFERS TO THE TIME PERIOD BETWEEN FULL CERVICAL DILATATION AND THE BIRTH OF
THE BABY. FOR WOMEN IN THE SECOND STAGE OF LABOR, THE FOLLOWING TECHNIQUES TO REDUCE PERINEAL
TRAUMA AND FACILITATE SPONTANEOUS BIRTH SUCH AS PERINEAL MASSAGE, WARM COMPRESSES, AND MANUAL
PERINEAL SUPPORT (HANDS-ON GUARDING OF THE PERINEUM) ARE RECOMMENDED.
OPTION A: MANDATORY EPISIOTOMY IS DISCOURAGED. EPISIOTOMY IS INDICATED IN CASES OF:
- SHOULDER DYSTOCIA
- BREECH DELIVERY
- FETAL MACROSOMIA
6033
- OPERATIVE VAGINAL DELIVERIES
- PERSISTENT OCCIPUT POSTERIOR POSITIONS
OPTION C: HEAD IS DELIVERED BY MAINTAINING FLEXION TO ENSURE THAT THE SMALL SUB-OCCIPITOFRONTAL
DIAMETER DISTENDS THE VULVAL OUTLET INSTEAD OF THE LARGER OCCIPITOFRONTAL DIAMETER.
OPTION D: THE POSITION THAT IS MOST COMFORTABLE TO THE MOTHER INCLUDING UPRIGHT POSITIONS IS
RECOMMENDED.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt:
A PRIMIGRAVIDA IS IN LABOUR. HER PER-VAGINAL EXAMINATION SHOWED A POSTERIOR CERVIX WITH 5
CM CERVICAL LENGTH, 1 CM DILATATION, SOFT CONSISTENCY, AND HEAD AT -1 STATION. CALCULATE THE
MODIFIED BISHOP SCORE.
questions.explanation:
THE MODIFIED BISHOP SCORE OF THE GIVEN PATIENT IS CALCULATED TO BE 5.
FROM THE DATA GIVEN IN THE QUESTION:
- THE POSITION OF THE CERVIX IS POSTERIOR, HENCE SCORE = 0
- CERVICAL LENGTH IS 5 CM, HENCE SCORE = 0
- CERVICAL DILATATION IS 1 CM, HENCE SCORE = 1
- CONSISTENCY OF CERVIX IS SOFT, HENCE SCORE = 2
- THE STATION OF THE HEAD IS –1, HENCE SCORE = 2
HENCE, THE MODIFIED BISHOP SCORE IS 0+0+1+2+2 = 5.
THE BISHOP SCORE IS A SCORING SYSTEM USED TO ASSESS LABOR INDUCTION OUTCOMES. IT IS BASED ON THE
STATION OF THE HEAD, DILATION, EFFACEMENT (OR LENGTH), POSITION, AND CONSISTENCY OF THE CERVIX NOTED
BY DOING A VAGINAL EXAMINATION.
ACCORDING TO THE NICE GUIDELINES, A SCORE OF >/=6 IS CONSIDERED FAVORABLE.
ACCORDING TO WILLIAMS OBSTETRICS 26TH EDITION, A SCORE >/=9 IS CONSIDERED FAVORABLE.
NOTE: IN THE MODIFIED BISHOP SCORE (1991) THE EFFACEMENT IS REPLACED BY THE CERVICAL LENGTH IN CM.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt:
A COUPLE PRESENTS TO THE INFERTILITY CLINIC WITH A NORMAL HYSTEROSALPINGOGRAM AND A SEMEN
ANALYSIS REPORT WITH AZOOSPERMIA. WHICH OF THESE IS THE NEXT BEST TEST TO DIFFERENTIATE
BETWEEN AN OBSTRUCTIVE AND A TESTICULAR CAUSE OF AZOOSPERMIA?
questions.explanation:
SERUM FSH LEVEL IS THE NEXT BEST TEST TO DIFFERENTIATE BETWEEN AN OBSTRUCTIVE AND A TESTICULAR CAUSE
OF AZOOSPERMIA. FSH IS THE MAIN HORMONE STIMULATING THE PRODUCTION OF SPERM IN THE TESTIS AND
HAS THE HIGHEST SPECIFICITY AND SENSITIVITY AMONG HORMONAL ASSAYS WHILE DIFFERENTIATING BETWEEN
OBSTRUCTIVE AND NON-OBSTRUCTIVE AZOOSPERMIA.
THE ABSENCE OF SPERM IN SEMEN IS KNOWN AS AZOOSPERMIA. IT CAN BE DUE TO:
- PRE-TESTICULAR AZOOSPERMIA DUE TO A HYPOTHALAMIC OR PITUITARY ABNORMALITY
(HYPOGONADOTROPIC-HYPOGONADISM)
- TESTICULAR FAILURE OR NON-OBSTRUCTIVE AZOOSPERMIA
- POST-TESTICULAR OBSTRUCTION IMPLIES NORMAL SPERMATOGENESIS BUT FAILURE TO DELIVER THE SPERM INTO
THE EJACULATE BECAUSE OF DUCTAL OBSTRUCTION.
6034
THE ALGORITHM FOR DIFFERENTIATING THE CAUSES OF NORMAL SEMEN VOLUME AZOOSPERMIA IS AS FOLLOWS:
- A LOW FSH LEVEL INDICATES PITUITARY OR HYPOTHALAMIC FAILURE
- A HIGH FSH LEVEL DENOTES PRIMARY GONADAL FAILURE OR TESTICULAR CAUSE
- A NORMAL FSH LEVEL COULD BE DUE TO EITHER NON-OBSTRUCTIVE OR OBSTRUCTIVE AZOOSPERMIA. A
TESTICULAR BIOPSY IS USUALLY REQUIRED IN SUCH PEOPLE TO PROVIDE A DEFINITIVE DIAGNOSIS.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt: SPECIFY THE DOSE OF DEXAMETHASONE GIVEN FOR FETAL LUNG MATURITY.
options: 4 DOSES OF 6 MG GIVEN 12 HOURS APART
questions.answer: 4 DOSES OF 6 MG GIVEN 12 HOURS APART
questions.explanation:
THE DOSAGE OF DEXAMETHASONE GIVEN FOR FETAL LUNG MATURITY IS 4 DOSES OF 6 MG, WHICH IS GIVEN 12
HOURS APART.
MATERNAL ADMINISTRATION OF GLUCOCORTICOIDS IS ADVISED IN PRETERM LABOR WHEN THE PERIOD OF
GESTATION IS LESS THAN 34 WEEKS. INTRAMUSCULAR INJECTION OF EITHER BETAMETHASONE OR
DEXAMETHASONE IS GIVEN.
DOSAGE:
- BETAMETHASONE (BETNESOL): 2 DOSES OF 12 MG EACH, GIVEN 24 HOURS APART.
- DEXAMETHASONE: 4 DOSES OF 6 MG EACH, GIVEN EVERY 12 HOURS.
THIS HELPS IN FETAL LUNG MATURATION AND MINIMIZE THE INCIDENCE OF:
- RESPIRATORY DISTRESS SYNDROME
- INTRAVENTRICULAR HEMORRHAGE
- NECROTIZING ENTEROCOLITIS
IT IS BENEFICIAL WHEN THE DELIVERY IS DELAYED BEYOND 48 HOURS AFTER THE FIRST DOSE.
6035

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt: SPECIFY THE DOSE OF CARBETOCIN USED IN THE PREVENTION OF POSTPARTUM HEMORRHAGE.
questions.explanation:
100 MCG OF CARBETOCIN IS USED IN THE PREVENTION OF POSTPARTUM HEMORRHAGE (PPH).
THE USE OF CARBETOCIN (100 µG, IM/IV) IS RECOMMENDED FOR THE PREVENTION OF PPH. IT IS A
LONG-ACTING SYNTHETIC ANALOG OF OXYTOCIN WITH AGONIST PROPERTIES. IT BINDS TO OXYTOCIN RECEPTORS IN
THE UTERINE SMOOTH MUSCLE, AND RESULTS IN RHYTHMIC CONTRACTIONS, INCREASED FREQUENCY OF EXISTING
CONTRACTIONS, AND INCREASED UTERINE TONE.
TO EFFECTIVELY PREVENT PPH, THE WHO RECOMMENDS THE USE OF ONLY ONE OF THE FOLLOWING UTEROTONIC
AGENTS:
- OXYTOCIN - (10 IU - IM/IV)
- CARBETOCIN - (100 µG - IM/IV)
- MISOPROSTOL - (400 µG OR 600 µG, PER-ORAL)
- ERGOMETRINE/METHYLERGOMETRINE - (200 µG - IM/IV)
- OXYTOCIN AND ERGOMETRINE FIXED-DOSE COMBINATION - (5 IU,500µG - IM)
OF THESE, OXYTOCIN IS USED AS THE FIRST-LINE AGENT IN PREVENTING POSTPARTUM HEMORRHAGE. WHEN
OXYTOCIN IS NOT AVAILABLE, THE OTHER DRUGS MENTIONED ABOVE CAN BE USED BASED ON THE CLINICAL
CONDITION AND AVAILABILITY OF THE DRUG.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt: MILK PRODUCTION IN PREGNANCY IS INHIBITED BY :
questions.explanation:
MILK PRODUCTION IN PREGNANCY IS INHIBITED BY HIGH ESTROGEN.
THE SYNTHESIS AND SECRETION OF MILK FROM THE BREAST ALVEOLI IS KNOWN AS LACTOGENESIS. PROLACTIN, AN
ANTERIOR PITUITARY HORMONE, IS RESPONSIBLE FOR LACTOGENESIS. IN SPITE OF HIGH PROLACTIN LEVELS DURING
PREGNANCY, THERE IS INHIBITION OF MILK SECRETION. THIS IS BECAUSE OF HIGH LEVELS OF ESTROGEN AND
PROGESTERONE CIRCULATING DURING PREGNANCY, WHICH MAKES THE BREAST TISSUES UNRESPONSIVE TO
PROLACTIN.
FOLLOWING DELIVERY, THERE IS A FALL IN ESTROGEN AND PROGESTERONE LEVELS. AS A RESULT, PROLACTIN BEGINS
ITS MILK SECRETORY ACTIVITY IN PREVIOUSLY FULLY DEVELOPED MAMMARY GLANDS.
OTHER HORMONES INVOLVED IN LACTOGENESIS:
- INSULIN
- GROWTH HORMONE
- CORTISOL
- THYROXINE
- PLACENTAL LACTOGEN AKA HUMAN CHORIONIC SOMATOMAMMOTROPIN: HAS GROWTH PROMOTING AND
LACTOGENIC EFFECTS
- SEROTONIN
OXYTOCIN IS THE MAJOR HORMONE FOR GALACTOKINESIS OR THE EJECTION OF MILK.
6036

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt: WHICH OF THESE EMERGENCY CONTRACEPTIVE IS USED IN INDIA?
questions.explanation:
LEVONORGESTREL (LNG) 1.5 MG IS THE EMERGENCY CONTRACEPTIVE USED IN INDIA.
EMERGENCY CONTRACEPTION REFERS TO BACKUP METHODS FOR CONTRACEPTIVE EMERGENCIES WHICH WOMEN
CAN USE WITHIN THE FIRST FEW DAYS AFTER UNPROTECTED INTERCOURSE TO PREVENT AN UNWANTED PREGNANCY.
LEVONORGESTREL 1.5 MG SINGLE DOSE CAN BE USED FOR EMERGENCY CONTRACEPTION. ALTERNATIVELY,
LEVONORGESTREL 0.75 MG ONE TABLET CAN BE TAKEN WITHIN 72 HOURS OF UNPROTECTED INTERCOURSE AND
ANOTHER TABLET 12 HOURS LATER.
NOTE: UNDER THE NATIONAL REPRODUCTIVE AND CHILD HEALTH PROGRAMME, THE DRUG CONTROLLER OF
INDIA HAS ONLY APPROVED LEVONORGESTREL TABLETS FOR USE AS AN EMERGENCY CONTRACEPTIVE PILL.
OTHER OPTIONS:
OPTION A: MISOPROSTOL IS A PROSTAGLANDIN E1 ANALOG USED IN THE MEDICAL TERMINATION OF PREGNANCY.
OPTION B: HIGH DOSES OF ETHINYLESTRADIOL CAN PROVIDE EMERGENCY CONTRACEPTION WHEN USED IN
COMBINATION WITH LEVONORGESTREL. THIS IS KNOWN AS THE YUZPE REGIME.
OPTION C: ULIPRISTAL IS A SYNTHETIC PROGESTERONE HORMONE RECEPTOR MODULATOR. IT ATTACHES TO THE
PROGESTERONE RECEPTOR AND PREVENTS/ DELAYS OVULATION, AND SUPPRESSES THE ENDOMETRIUM, THEREBY
PREVENTING IMPLANTATION. ULIPRISTAL 30 MG SHOULD BE TAKEN WITHIN 5 DAYS OF UNPROTECTED SEXUAL
INTERCOURSE. IT IS APPROVED BY US-FDA AND EUROPEAN MEDICINE AGENCIES BUT AT PRESENT, IT IS NOT
AVAILABLE IN INDIA AS AN EMERGENCY CONTRACEPTIVE PILL.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt: WHICH OF THESE IS NOT A LONG-ACTING REVERSIBLE CONTRACEPTIVE METHOD?
questions.explanation:
LAPAROSCOPIC TUBAL LIGATION IS AN IRREVERSIBLE METHOD OF CONTRACEPTION.
STERILIZATION IS A PERMANENT METHOD OF BIRTH CONTROL. IT INCLUDES SURGICAL PROCEDURES LIKE
TUBECTOMY IN WOMAN AND VASECTOMY IN MAN. THESE METHODS ARE ADVISED FOR THOSE COUPLES, WHO
HAVE COMPLETED THEIR FAMILIES AND DO NOT WANT TO BEAR THE INCONVENIENCE OR COST OF THE OTHER
METHODS OF CONTRACEPTION, AND WHEN THE OTHER METHODS ARE CONTRAINDICATED.
- POSTPARTUM STERILIZATION IS PERFORMED IN THE FIRST WEEK OF THE POSTNATAL PERIOD. IT CAN
BE COMBINED WITH A CESAREAN SECTION
- INTERVAL STERILIZATION IS DONE IN NON-PREGNANT WOMEN OR AT ANY TIME AFTER 6 WEEKS OF DELIVERY.
TUBAL STERILIZATION CAN BE ACHIEVED BY THREE METHODS WHICH ARE:
- ELECTROCOAGULATION IS USED FOR THE DESTRUCTION OF A SEGMENT OF THE TUBE
- MECHANICAL OCCLUSION OF THE TUBE USING A SILICONE RUBBER BAND (FALOPE RING) OR A SPRING-LOADED
CLIP (HULKA CLEMENS CLIP)
- SUTURE LIGATION WITH OR WITHOUT TUBAL SEGMENT EXCISION SUCH AS POMEROY'S METHOD, UCHIDA'S
METHOD, IRVING'S METHOD, ETC.
6037
OTHER OPTIONS:
OPTION A: COPPER T (CUT) IS AN EFFECTIVE, REVERSIBLE, AND LONG-TERM METHOD OF CONTRACEPTION.
ABOUT 50 MCG OF COPPER IS ELUTED DAILY IN THE UTERUS. IT CAN BE LEFT IN PLACE FOR A LONG TIME AND
DOES NOT INTERFERE WITH SEXUAL ACTIVITY. THEY HAVE AN EFFECTIVE LIFE OF ABOUT 3–5 YEARS. COPPER T
380A, KNOWN AS PARAGUARD, HAS A LIFESPAN OF 10 YEARS.
OPTION B: IMPLANON IS A SUBDERMAL IMPLANT THAT CONTAINS 67MG OF DESOGESTREL. IT RELEASES 30
MCG OF THE DESOGESTREL DAILY AND THE EFFECT LASTS FOR UP TO 3 YEARS. IT PREVENTS OVULATION AND IS
REVERSIBLE WITHIN 1 MONTH OF REMOVAL.
OPTION D: COMBINED ORAL CONTRACEPTIVE PILLS (OCP) CONTAIN A MIXTURE OF ETHINYLOESTRADIOL WITH
PROGESTOGEN. IT ACTS BY SUPPRESSING PITUITARY HORMONES I.E. FSH AND LH PEAK AND THEREBY
PREVENTING OVULATION. IT IS A REVERSIBLE METHOD OF CONTRACEPTION AS 90% OF WOMEN WILL HAVE
NORMAL OVULATORY CYCLES WITHIN 3 MONTHS OF STOPPING OCPS.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt: INDICATE WHICH CLASS OF OVARIAN TUMOR DOES CLEAR CELL CARCINOMA OF THE OVARY BELONG TO.
questions.explanation:
CLEAR CELL CARCINOMA OF THE OVARY IS A TYPE OF EPITHELIAL CELL TUMOR.
EPITHELIAL OVARIAN TUMORS ARISE FROM THE MESOEPITHELIAL CELLS PRESENT ON THE OVARIAN SURFACE. 80%
OF ALL OVARIAN CANCERS ARE EPITHELIAL CANCERS.
CLEAR CELL CARCINOMA IS ALSO KNOWN AS MESONEPHROID TUMOR. THE HISTOPATHOLOGY OF CLEAR CELL
CARCINOMA REVEALS LARGE CUBOIDAL EPITHELIAL CELLS WITH ABUNDANT CLEAR CYTOPLASM CHARACTERISTICALLY
FORMING TUBULES, GLANDS, AND SMALL CYSTIC SPACES. THESE CYSTIC SPACES ARE LINED BY HOBNAIL CELLS.
THEY ARE CLEAR CELLS SHOWING LARGE DARK NUCLEI PROTRUDING INTO THE LUMEN. IT IS A HIGHLY MALIGNANT
TUMOR.
MALIGNANT EPITHELIAL TUMORS CAN SPREAD WIDELY VIA TRANSCOELOMIC SPREAD. IT CAN SPREAD THROUGH
THE CAPSULE ONTO THE PERITONEAL SURFACE, OMENTUM, INTESTINAL VISCERA, AND SUB-DIAPHRAGMATIC
SPACE. AN ASCITIC TAP WILL REVEAL BLOOD-STAINED FLUID WITH TUMOR CELLS. IT MAY ALSO SPREAD TO THE
PARA-AORTIC NODES AND CAUSE METASTASIS IN THE OTHER OVARY, LIVER, LUNGS, AND GASTROINTESTINAL TRACT.
6038

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt: ASHERMAN SYNDROME IS MOST COMMONLY ASSOCIATED WITH
questions.explanation:
AMONG THE GIVEN OPTIONS, ASHERMAN SYNDROME IS MOST COMMONLY ASSOCIATED WITH
HYPOMENORRHEA.
ASHERMAN SYNDROME IS THE PRESENCE OF UTERINE SYNECHIAE, DUE TO THE DESTRUCTION OF THE
ENDOMETRIUM. IT CAN OCCUR AS A RESULT OF TRAUMA TO THE ENDOMETRIUM FOLLOWING VIGOROUS
CURETTAGES SUCH AS INCOMPLETE ABORTION, POSTPARTUM HEMORRHAGE, AND ELECTIVE ABORTION. DAMAGE
MAY ALSO RESULT FROM OTHER UTERINE SURGERY SUCH AS METROPLASTY, MYOMECTOMY.
THEY USUALLY PRESENT WITH MENSTRUAL ABNORMALITIES, INFERTILITY, RECURRENT PREGNANCY LOSS DUE TO
INADEQUATE PLACENTATION. MENSTRUAL ABNORMALITIES, INCLUDING HYPOMENORRHEA AND AMENORRHEA,
REMAIN THE MOST COMMON CLINICAL FEATURES ASSOCIATED WITH ASHERMAN SYNDROME. DYSMENORRHEA IS
OCCASIONALLY PRESENT.
THE DIAGNOSIS IS CONFIRMED WITH HYSTEROSALPINGOGRAPHY.
MANAGEMENT INCLUDES HYSTEROSCOPY, WHICH ENABLES ADHESIOLYSIS. RECURRENCE OF ADHESIONS IS
PREVENTED BY INSERTION OF IUCD FOR 3 MONTHS AND GIVING ESTROGEN CYCLICALLY (21 DAYS) FOR 3 MONTHS
TO DEVELOP ENDOMETRIUM.
NOTE:
AMENORRHEA INDICATES THE COMPLETE ABSENCE OF MENSTRUATION.
OLIGOMENORRHOEA IS THE TERM USED TO DESCRIBE INFREQUENT AND IRREGULAR MENSES. IN THIS CONDITION,
THE CYCLE LENGTH IS PROLONGED WITHOUT AFFECTING THE DURATION AND AMOUNT OF FLOW.
HYPOMENORRHOEA REFERS TO THE CONDITION IN WHICH THE CYCLE LENGTH REMAINS UNALTERED, HOWEVER THE
DURATION OF BLEEDING OR THE AMOUNT OF BLOOD LOSS, OR BOTH ARE SUBSTANTIALLY REDUCED.
MENORRHAGIA DENOTES EXCESSIVE BLOOD LOSS (INCREASE IN THE DURATION AND /OR AMOUNT OF BLEEDING)
WITHOUT ANY CHANGE IN THE CYCLE LENGTH.
DYSMENORRHOEA IS DEFINED AS CRAMPING PAIN ACCOMPANYING MENSTRUATION.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt:
A TEENAGE GIRL PRESENTED WITH IRREGULAR CYCLES AND INCREASED FACIAL HAIR. HER OVARIES SHOWED
INCREASED VOLUME. WHICH OF THESE ARE USED IN THE FIRST LINE TREATMENT?
questions.explanation:
Source note: The source PDF omits the numbered statements or table referenced by this question.

THIS PATIENT'S IRREGULAR MENSTRUAL CYCLES, INCREASED FACIAL HAIR (SIGNIFYING CLINICAL
HYPERANDROGENISM), AND INCREASED OVARIAN VOLUME ARE SUGGESTIVE OF POLYCYSTIC OVARIAN SYNDROME
(PCOS). ANTI-ANDROGENS, LIFESTYLE MODIFICATIONS, AND COMBINED ORAL CONTRACEPTIVES (2, 3, AND 4)
CONSTITUE FIRST-LINE TREATMENT MODALITIES FOR THIS CONDITION. LAPAROSCOPIC DRILLING IS A SURGICAL
PROCEDURE DONE WHEN MEDICAL THERAPY FAILS.
PCOS IS AN ENDOCRINOPATHY SEEN IN WOMEN OF REPRODUCTIVE AGE, AFFECTING MULTIPLE
SYSTEMS. ROTTERDAM CRITERIA IS USED TO DIAGNOSE PCOD. THE PRESENCE OF TWO OF THE THREE
COMPONENTS OF THIS CRITERIA ESTABLISHES THE DIAGNOSIS:
- OLIGO/AMENORRHOEA, ANOVULATION, INFERTILITY
- HIRSUTISM/ACNE
6039
- ULTRASOUND FINDINGS:
- ENLARGED OVARIES WITH OVARIAN VOLUME WILL BE MORE THAN 10 MM3
- 12 OR MORE SMALL FOLLICLES EACH OF 2-9 MM IN SIZE PLACED PERIPHERALLY
ULTRASOUND IMAGE GIVEN BELOW SHOWS AN ENLARGED OVARY SEEN IN PCOS WITH MULTIPLE FOLLICLES IN THE
PERIPHERY.
TREATMENT OF PCOD:
- WEIGHT REDUCTION ALONE IS BENEFICIAL IN MILD HIRSUTISM.
- LIFESTYLE CHANGES, SUCH AS SMOKING CESSATION, ARE RECOMMENDED.
- FOURTH-GENERATION ORAL CONTRACEPTIVE PILLS (OCP) CONTAINING ETHINYL ESTRADIOL AND DROSPIRENONE
ARE USED FOR TREATING MENSTRUAL ABNORMALITIES, REDUCING ACNE, AND HIRSUTISM.
- OCP WITH CYPROTERONE ACETATE IS PRESCRIBED FOR PCOS PATIENTS WITH HIRSUTISM.
- PATIENTS WITH PCOD ARE PRONE TO DEVELOPING INSULIN RESISTANCE, WHICH CAN BE CONTROLLED
WITH METFORMIN. ACARBOSECAN BE USED AS AN ALTERNATIVE IF METFORMIN IS CONTRAINDICATED.
- INFERTILITY IN PCOD PATIENTS IS TREATED WITH CLOMIPHENE AS THE FIRST-LINE DRUG FOR INDUCING
OVULATION. DEXAMETHASONE IS USED IN COMBINATION TO IMPROVE FERTILITY RATES. LETROZOLE IS USED
OFF-LABEL IN CLOMIPHENE-RESISTANT CASES.
SURGICAL OPTIONS INCLUDE LAPAROSCOPIC OVARIAN DRILLING OR PUNCTURE OF NOT MORE THAN FOUR CYSTS IN
EACH OVARY. THIS IS DONE EITHER BY LASER OR BY UNIPOLAR ELECTROCAUTERY. IT RESTORES ENDOCRINE LEVELS
AND IMPROVES FERTILITY. SURGERY IS INDICATED ONLY IF:
- MEDICAL THERAPY FAILS
- HYPERSTIMULATION OCCURS
- INFERTILE WOMEN
- PREVIOUS PREGNANCY LOSSES
6040

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt: SELECT THE INSTRUMENT PROVIDED BELOW.
questions.explanation:
THE INSTRUMENT SHOWN IN THE IMAGE IS CUSCO’S SPECULUM.
CUSCO’S SPECULUM IS A SELF-RETAINING BIVALVE SPECULUM USED FOR VISUALISATION OF THE CERVIX, VAGINAL
FORNICES AND FOR PERFORMING PAP SMEAR.
OTHER OPTIONS:
OPTION B: SIMS' SPECULUM IS USED FOR THE ASSESSMENT OF RECTOCELE AND CYSTOCELE. THE SPECULUM IS
APPLIED AGAINST THE VAGINAL WALL AND SLOWLY RETRACTED OUT UNTIL A BULGE APPEARS, INDICATING
CYSTOCELE OR RECTOCELE. IT CAN ALSO BE USED FOR VISUALIZATION OF THE VAGINAL WALLS.
OPTION C: A SURGEON USES A LUBRICATED PROCTOSCOPE TO VISUALIZE LESIONS IN THE ANUS, ANORECTAL
JUNCTION, AND LOWER RECTUM. IT IS DONE AS AN OPD PROCEDURE TO DETECT HEMORRHOIDS, POLYPS, OR
ULCERS.
6041
OPTION D: DOYEN'S RETRACTOR IS USED TO RETRACT THE ABDOMINAL WALL AS WELL AS THE BLADDER TO
FACILITATE BETTER EXPOSURE OF THE LOWER UTERINE SEGMENT DURING CESARIAN OPERATION. IT IS ALSO USED TO
PULL BACK THE SOFT TISSUES TO WIDEN THE SURGICAL FIELD DURING LAPAROTOMY.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt:
A 17-YEAR-OLD GIRL WAS BROUGHT BY HER MOTHER TO THE OUTPATIENT DEPARTMENT WITH PRIMARY
AMENORRHEA. SHE HAD NORMAL BREAST DEVELOPMENT AND PUBIC HAIR. UPON EXAMINATION, THE VAGINA
WAS BLIND-ENDING AND THE UTERUS WAS NOT PALPABLE. SPECIFY THE MOST PROBABLE DIAGNOSIS.
questions.explanation:
THE GIVEN CLINICAL SCENARIO OF A GIRL WITH PRIMARY AMENORRHEA, NORMAL BREASTS, AND PUBIC HAIR,
WITH A BLIND-ENDING VAGINA AND UTERUS NOT PALPABLE, IS SUGGESTIVE OF MULLERIAN AGENESIS.
ABSENT UTERUS AND VAGINA IN A PERSON WITH FEMALE GENOTYPE AND PHENOTYPE ARE FEATURES OF
MULLERIAN AGENESIS, ALSO KNOWN AS MAYER-ROKITANSKY-KUSTER-HAUSER SYNDROME.
OVARIES ARE NORMAL AND SECONDARY SEXUAL CHARACTERS ARE WELL DEVELOPED WITH NORMAL EXTERNAL
GENITALIA. THIS CONDITION IS ASSOCIATED WITH ANOMALIES OF THE SPINE/SKELETON AND THE KIDNEYS ALONG
6042
WITH THE URINARY TRACT.
DIAGNOSIS IS MADE WITH THE HELP OF PELVIC SONOGRAPHY, MRI, AND LAPAROSCOPY. PATIENTS MAY HAVE
RUDIMENTARY MULLERIAN BULBS WITHOUT AN ENDOMETRIAL CAVITY. THESE SHOULD BE SURGICALLY EXCISED IF
THEY ARE SYMPTOMATIC.
OTHER OPTIONS:
OPTION B: GONADAL DYSGENESIS PATIENTS PRESENT WITH PRIMARY AMENORRHOEA, ABSENCE OF SECONDARY
SEX CHARACTERS (POORLY DEVELOPED BREASTS), AND FEMALE EXTERNAL GENITALIA.
OPTION C: IN TURNER SYNDROME, SHORT STATURE WITH POOR DEVELOPMENT OF SECONDARY SEXUAL
CHARACTERS AND SHORT STATURE WILL BE SEEN. IT HAS A KARYOTYPE OF 45 XO. BARR BODY WILL BE ABSENT.
FEMALE GENITAL ORGANS (VAGINA, UTERUS, FALLOPIAN TUBES, OVARIES) ARE PRESENT. THE OVARIES, THOUGH
PRESENT, ARE ATROPHIC.
OPTION D: TESTICULAR FEMINIZATION SYNDROME ALSO KNOWN AS ANDROGEN INSENSITIVITY SYNDROME HAS A
KARYOTYPE OF 46XY. SECONDARY SEXUAL CHARACTERS LIKE THE DEVELOPMENT OF AXILLARY HAIR AND PUBIC
HAIR ARE ABSENT IN THESE FEMALES. HOWEVER, BREAST DEVELOPMENT IS ADEQUATE DUE TO THE CONVERSION
OF ANDROGEN INTO ESTROGEN DURING PUBERTY.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt:
A 24-YEAR-OLD FEMALE REPORTS FOUL-SMELLING VAGINAL DISCHARGE. WET SMEAR
OF THE DISCHARGE IS DISPLAYED BELOW. WHAT IS DRUG OF CHOICE TO TREAT THIS CONDITION?
questions.explanation:
A FEMALE PATIENT PRESENTING WITH FOUL-SMELLING VAGINAL DISCHARGE AND A WET SMEAR SHOWING CLUE
CELLS POINTS TO A DIAGNOSIS OF BACTERIAL VAGINOSIS, AND THE DRUG OF CHOICE IS METRONIDAZOLE.
BACTERIAL VAGINOSIS IS A POLYMICROBIAL INFECTION CAUSED BY MOBILUNCUS CURTISII, GARDNERELLA
VAGINALIS, MYCOPLASMA HOMINIS, AND HAEMOPHILUS VAGINALIS. IT HAS A FOUL-SMELLING (FISHY SMELL)
VAGINAL DISCHARGE WITH MINIMAL VULVAL IRRITATION.
AMSEL'S CRITERIA IS HELPFUL IN DIAGNOSING BACTERIAL VAGINOSIS WHEN 3 OF THE FOLLOWING 4 ARE PRESENT:
- THIN, WHITE HOMOGENOUS VAGINAL DISCHARGE
- A PH OF VAGINAL FLUID >4.5
- FISHY ODOR OF DISCHARGE ACCENTUATED BY ADDING 10% KOH-WHIFF TEST
- PRESENCE OF CLUE CELLS ON MICROSCOPY: CLUE CELLS ARE EPITHELIAL CELLS WITH A FUZZY BORDER
OR GRANULAR CYTOPLASM CAUSED BY SMALL GRAM-NEGATIVE BACILLI ADHERING TO THEIR SURFACE
TREATMENT IS ORAL METRONIDAZOLE 500 MG BD FOR 7 DAYS.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt: WHICH OF THESE MODALITIES ARE USED FOR THE DIAGNOSIS OF PLACENTA ACCRETA?
questions.explanation:
AMONG THE GIVEN OPTIONS, ULTRASONOGRAPHY AND MRI CAN BE USED IN THE DIAGNOSIS OF PLACENTA
ACCRETA.
THE TERM PLACENTA ACCRETA SPECTRUM (PAS)/MORBIDLY ADHERENT PLACENTA REFERS TO ABNORMAL
PLACENTAL IMPLANTATION CHARACTERIZED BY THE ABNORMALLY IMPLANTED, INVASIVE, OR ADHERED
PLACENTA. THIS IS DUE TO THE ABSENCE OF DECIDUA BASALIS AND POOR DEVELOPMENT OF THE FIBRINOID OR
NITABUCH LAYER.
RISK FACTORS INCLUDE PRIOR CESARIAN DELIVERY, PRIOR UTERINE SURGERY, PRIOR CURETTAGE, AND
ENDOMETRIAL ABLATION, ASSOCIATED PLACENTA PREVIA.
TYPES OF THE MORBIDLY ADHERENT PLACENTA:
- PLACENTA ACCRETA: VILLI ARE ATTACHED TO THE MYOMETRIUM.
- PLACENTA INCRETA: VILLI INVADE THE MYOMETRIUM.
- PLACENTA PERCRETA: VILLI PENETRATE THROUGH THE MYOMETRIUM AND TO OR THROUGH THE SEROSA.
ULTRASOUND IMAGING, COLOR DOPPLER, AND MRI HAVE ALL BEEN USEFUL IN THE DIAGNOSIS OF MORBIDLY
ADHERENT PLACENTA DURING PREGNANCY.
USG FINDINGS THAT SUGGEST PAS ARE (1) PLACENTAL LACUNAE, (2) THINNING OF THE RETROPLACENTAL
MYOMETRIUM, (3) DISRUPTION OF THE BLADDER-UTERINE SEROSAL INTERFACE, (4) BRIDGING VESSELS FROM THE
PLACENTA TO THE BLADDER-SEROSAL INTERFACE, AND (5) A PLACENTAL BULGE THAT PUSHES OUTWARD AND
DISTORTS THE CONTOUR OF THE UTERUS.
COLOR FLOW DOPPLER STUDY SHOWS HYPERVASCULARITY OF SEROSA BLADDER INTERFACE.
MRI REVEALS UTERINE BULGING AND DARK INTRAPLACENTAL BANDS ON T2-WEIGHTED IMAGING.
MANAGEMENT:
- PARTIAL PLACENTA ACCRETA: PLACENTAL TISSUE IS REMOVED AS MUCH AS POSSIBLE. OXYTOCIN HELPS IN
UTERINE CONTRACTION AND HEMOSTASIS. IN CASES FOLLOWING CESAREAN DELIVERY, BLEEDING AREAS ARE
OVERSEWED.
- TOTAL PLACENTA ACCRETA:
- PAROUS WOMEN- HYSTERECTOMY IS DONE
- IF THE PATIENT DESIRES TO HAVE A CHILD- CONSERVATIVE MEASURES INCLUDE INCISING THE UTERUS ABOVE THE
PLACENTAL ATTACHMENT, CLAMPING, AND CUTTING THE UMBILICAL CORD AS CLOSE TO ITS BASE AS POSSIBLE. THE
PLACENTA IS LEFT BEHIND, WHICH MAY GET AUTOLYZED EVENTUALLY. UTERINE ARTERY EMBOLIZATION OR
THERAPY WITH METHOTREXATE HAS ALSO BEEN DONE FOR THE CONSERVATION OF THE UTERUS.
- IF PLACENTA ACCRETA INVADES THE BLADDER, PLACENTAL REMOVAL ALONE IS AVOIDED. IT REQUIRES A
HYSTERECTOMY AND PARTIAL CYSTECTOMY.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt: A pregnant woman at 36 weeks of gestation with a prosthetic valve replacement for mitral stenosis is on warfarin therapy. Her INR is 3. Specify the appropriate next step in management . LMWH- Low Molecular Weight Heparin
options: STOP WARFARIN, START LMWH AND ASPRIN
questions.explanation:
THE NEXT APPROPRIATE STEP IN THE MANAGEMENT OF A PREGNANT WOMAN WITH A PROSTHETIC VALVE ON
WARFARIN THERAPY AT 36 WEEKS OF GESTATION IS TO STOP WARFARIN AND START LOW MOLECULAR WEIGHT
HEPARIN (LMWH).
WARFARIN IS SAFE AND EFFECTIVE IN PREVENTING THROMBOEMBOLISM IN THE MOTHER DURING THE 2ND
TRIMESTER. HOWEVER, IT IS TERATOGENIC AND CAN LEAD TO MISCARRIAGE, STILLBIRTHS, FETAL ANTICOAGULATION,
AND FETAL EMBRYOPATHY IF USED IN THE 1ST TRIMESTER.
HEPARIN IS SAFE FOR THE FETUS AS IT DOES NOT CROSS THE PLACENTA BUT IS LESS EFFECTIVE THAN WARFARIN IN
PREVENTING THROMBOEMBOLISM.
LMWH- LOW MOLECULAR WEIGHT HEPARIN, UFH- UNFRACTIONATED HEPARIN
FOR PATIENTS TAKING LMWH, FACTOR XA LEVELS SHOULD BE MONITORED WEEKLY.
HEPARIN SHOULD BE DISCONTINUED JUST BEFORE (AT LEAST 6 HOURS BEFORE) DELIVERY. IF DELIVERY OCCURS
BEFORE DISCONTINUATION AND THERE IS EXTENSIVE BLEEDING, THEN IV PROTAMINE SULFATE CAN BE GIVEN.
6053
WARFARIN OR HEPARIN ANTICOAGULATION CAN BE RESTARTED AFTER 6 HOURS OF VAGINAL DELIVERY, USUALLY
WITHOUT ANY PROBLEM.
WARFARIN, LMWH, AND UFH DO NOT ACCUMULATE IN BREAST MILK AND DO NOT HAVE AN ANTICOAGULANT
EFFECT IN THE NEWBORN. THEY ARE COMPATIBLE WITH BREASTFEEDING.
OTHER OPTIONS:
OPTION B: UNFRACTIONATED HEPARIN CAN ALSO BE GIVEN INSTEAD OF LMWH. HOWEVER, IN THIS CASE, THE
BETTER ANSWER IS TO GIVE LMWH; BECAUSE, IN CLINICAL PRACTICE, LMWHS HAVE A LONG HALF-LIFE,
ONCE-DAILY DOSING, AND FEWER SIDE EFFECTS. IF LMWH IS UNAVAILABLE OR COST-PROHIBITIVE, OR IF ANTI-XA
LEVELS CANNOT BE MONITORED, CONTINUOUS INFUSION OF UFH CAN BE USED AS AN ALTERNATIVE TO LMWH.
OPTION D: ASPIRIN 75-100 MG CAN BE GIVEN DAILY DURING PREGNANCY. IT CAN BE CONTINUED IN WOMEN
WITH MECHANICAL HEART VALVES IF NEEDED FOR OTHER INDICATIONS.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt:
A 27-YEAR-OLD FEMALE PATIENT WAS FOUND TO HAVE UTERUS DIDELPHYS. WHICH OF THESE IS
NOT LIKELY TO BE A COMPLICATION OF THIS UTERINE ANOMALY?
questions.explanation:
AMONG THE GIVEN OPTIONS, TRANSVERSE LIE IS NOT A LIKELY COMPLICATION OF UTERUS DIDELPHYS. A
TRANSVERSE LIE IS MORE LIKELY TO BE SEEN WITH AN ARCUATE OR SUB-SEPTATE UTERUS.
A UTERUS DIDELPHYS IS A MULLERIAN DEFECT CHARACTERIZED BY TWO SEPARATE UTERINE HORNS, EACH WITH AN
ENDOMETRIAL CAVITY AND UTERINE CERVIX. IT OCCURS DUE TO THE FAILURE OF FUSION OF THE MüLLERIAN DUCTS.
IT IS USUALLY ASYMPTOMATIC BUT CAN RARELY PRESENT WITH DYSPAREUNIA, DYSMENORRHEA, HEMATOCOLPOS,
AND HEMATOMETRA. RARELY, ENDOMETRIOSIS (OPTION B) AND GENITAL NEOPLASMS MAY BE ASSOCIATED WITH
UTERUS DIDELPHYS.
PREGNANCY IS POSSIBLE WITH UTERUS DIDELPHYS, HOWEVER, THERE IS AN INCREASED RISK OF THE FOLLOWING
COMPLICATIONS:
- SPONTANEOUS ABORTION (OPTION A)
- PRETERM LABOR (OPTION C)
- BREECH PRESENTATION
- CESAREAN DELIVERY
- INTRAUTERINE GROWTH RESTRICTION
- LOW BIRTH WEIGHT (<2.5KG)
- PERINATAL DEATH
6054
UTERUS DIDELPHYS CAN BE DIAGNOSED WITH ULTRASOUND OR HYSTEROSALPINGOGRAPHY, BUT MRI PROVIDES
THE MOST ACCURATE DIAGNOSIS.

A WOMAN WHO UNDERWENT DILATATION AND CURETTAGE FOR MOLAR PREGNANCY 6 MONTHS AGO
PRESENTS WITH PERSISTENT SYMPTOMS OF ABDOMINAL PAIN AND DISTENTION. ON FURTHER EVALUATION,
THE BETA-HCG LEVELS WERE PERSISTENTLY ELEVATED AND CANNONBALL FOCI WERE FOUND ON THE CHEST
X-RAY. SPECIFY THE APPROPRIATE MANAGEMENT IN THIS SITUATION.
questions.explanation:
THE GIVEN CLINICAL SCENARIO OF A WOMAN WITH A PAST HISTORY OF D(&)C FOR MOLAR PREGNANCY,
NOW PRESENTING WITH ABDOMINAL PAIN AND DISTENSION, ELEVATED BETA-HCG LEVELS, AND CANNONBALL
METASTASIS TO THE LUNG IS SUGGESTIVE OF GESTATIONAL TROPHOBLASTIC NEOPLASIA (GTN).
THE NEXT STEP IS TO CATEGORIZE THE PATIENT AS LOW/HIGH RISK BASED ON THE WHO PROGNOSTIC SCORING
SYSTEM TO DECIDE THE TREATMENT MODALITY.
WHO PROGNOSTIC SCORING SYSTEM, ADAPTED BY FIGO:

LOW-RISK GTN (FIGO STAGES I-III: SCORE <7): SINGLE-AGENT CHEMOTHERAPY WITH METHOTREXATE

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt:
A FEMALE PATIENT HAS A HISTORY OF THREE MISCARRIAGES. IDENTIFY THE INVESTIGATION THAT WAS DONE
FROM THE IMAGE DISPLAYED BELOW.
questions.explanation:
THE INVESTIGATION SHOWN IN THE GIVEN IMAGE IS HYSTEROSALPINGOGRAPHY. THE GIVEN
HYSTEROSALPINGOGRAM SHOWS A UNICORNUATE UTERUS.
HYSTEROSALPINGOGRAPHY (HSG) IS AN IMAGING MODALITY IN WHICH RADIOPAQUE CONTRAST IS INJECTED
THROUGH THE CERVICAL CANAL TO ASSESS THE ENDOMETRIAL CAVITY, THE FALLOPIAN TUBES, AND THE
ENDOCERVICAL CANAL.
HSG SHOULD BE DONE BETWEEN DAYS 5 AND 10 OF THE MENSTRUAL CYCLE, IN THE PREOVULATORY PHASE, AS
AN OUTPATIENT PROCEDURE. LEECH WILKINSON CANNULA, RUBIN'S CANNULA, OR FOLEY'S CATHETER NO.14 IS
INTRODUCED INTO THE ENDOMETRIAL CAVITY THROUGH THE CERVICAL OS, AND THE CONTRAST IS INJECTED. THE
UTERINE CAVITY AND FALLOPIAN TUBES ARE THEN VISUALIZED AND X-RAYS ARE OBTAINED.
HSG CAN BE USED FOR THE FOLLOWING:
- TO ASSESS TUBAL PATENCY IN INFERTILITY
- TO DETECT UTERINE ANOMALIES, SYNECHIAE, AND POLYPS
- TO DETECT INCOMPETENCE OF THE CERVICAL OS
CONTRAINDICATIONS TO HSG:
- ACUTE PELVIC INFECTION
- ACTIVE UTERINE BLEEDING
- PREGNANCY/ SUSPECTED PREGNANCY
- CONTRAST ALLERGY
- PREMENSTRUAL PHASE
HSG IS A SAFE PROCEDURE, HOWEVER, COMPLICATIONS SUCH AS ASCENDING SPREAD OF INFECTION, CHEMICAL
PERITONITIS, ALLERGIC REACTION TO THE DYE, OR PELVIC ENDOMETRIOSIS MAY OCCUR.
6057
OTHER OPTIONS:
OPTION A: HYSTEROSCOPY IS AN OPERATIVE PROCEDURE IN WHICH THE UTERINE CAVITY CAN BE VISUALIZED BY
PASSING A FIBEROPTIC TELESCOPE VIA THE CERVIX. IT CAN BE DIAGNOSTIC OR THERAPEUTIC. A HYSTEROSCOPIC
IMAGE OF A UTERUS WITH CARCINOMA IS SHOWN BELOW.
6058
OPTION B: SALINE INFUSION SONOGRAPHY IS A PROCEDURE WHERE NORMAL SALINE IS INJECTED INTO THE
UTERINE CAVITY AND THE UTERUS IS IMAGED WITH TRANSVAGINAL SONOGRAPHY. IT IS SHOWN IN THE IMAGE
BELOW.
OPTION D: TRANSVAGINAL ULTRASONOGRAPHY IS A NONINVASIVE IMAGING TECHNIQUE USING THE
TRANSVAGINAL APPROACH. IT PROVIDES A MORE DETAILED EVALUATION OF THE PELVIC ORGANS AS COMPARED TO
THE TRANSABDOMINAL APPROACH.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt:
A 56-YEAR-OLD MULTIPARA WOMAN PRESENTED WITH GRADE II/III UTERINE PROLAPSE WITH CYSTOCELE.
SHE REPORTS PASSING URINE ON COUGHING AND SNEEZING. SPECIFY THE TYPE OF URINARY
INCONTINENCE SEEN IN THE PATIENT DESCRIBED.
questions.explanation:
THE TYPE OF URINARY INCONTINENCE PRESENT IN A PATIENT WITH PROLAPSE AND CYSTOCELE EXPERIENCING
URINATION ON COUGHING AND SNEEZING IS STRESS INCONTINENCE.
6059
STRESS INCONTINENCE REFERS TO THE INVOLUNTARY LEAKAGE OF URINE WHEN THERE IS INCREASED
INTRA-ABDOMINAL PRESSURE (EG, COUGHING, SNEEZING, LAUGHING, VALSALVA MANEUVER). ABSENCE OF
DETRUSOR MUSCLE CONTRACTION IS SEEN IN URODYNAMIC STUDIES.
CAUSES:
- AGE AND MENOPAUSE - DUE TO ESTROGEN DEFICIENCY
- MULTIPARITY - DUE TO LOSS OF PELVIC MUSCLE TONE
- OBESITY
- SMOKING
- CONSTIPATION, CHRONIC COUGH
- PELVIC ORGAN PROLAPSE
- PREGNANCY - DUE TO THE EFFECT OF PROGESTERONE AND PRESSURE OF THE GRAVID UTERUS ON THE BLADDER
NECK.
- PUERPERIUM - DUE TO DESCENT OF THE BLADDER NECK, LOSS OF URETHRO-VESICAL ANGLE, AND REDUCED
PELVIC MUSCLE TONE
- SURGICAL REPAIR OF VESICOVAGINAL FISTULA
GRADING OF GENUINE STRESS INCONTINENCE (GSI) :
- GRADE I: INCONTINENCE WITH ONLY SEVERE STRESS, SUCH AS COUGHING, SNEEZING, AND JOGGING.
- GRADE II: INCONTINENCE WITH MODERATE STRESS, SUCH AS FAST WALK, GOING UP AND DOWN THE STAIRS.
- GRADE III: INCONTINENCE WITH MILD STRESS SUCH AS STANDING.
INVESTIGATIONS ARE ONLY DONE PRIOR TO SURGERY TO CONFIRM THE DIAGNOSIS. THEY INCLUDE:
- STRESS TEST
- COTTON SWAB OR Q-TIP TEST
- MARSHALL AND BONNEY’S TEST
- URETHROSCOPY
- URODYNAMIC STUDIES.
THESE ARE NOT REQUIRED PRIOR TO CONSERVATIVE MANAGEMENT.
CONSERVATIVE MANAGEMENT INCLUDES KEGEL'S PELVIC EXERCISES, ELECTRIC NERVE STIMULATION, DEVICES LIKE
PESSARIES, VAGINAL CONES, AND ARTIFICIAL SPHINCTERS. MEDICAL TREATMENT WITH ESTROGEN CREAMS, ALPHA
AGONISTS, VENLAFAXINE, AND IMIPRAMINE MAY BE USEFUL.
OTHER OPTIONS:
OPTION A: OVERFLOW INCONTINENCE IS AN OLD TERM THAT REFERS TO THE INABILITY TO EMPTY THE BLADDER,
WITH INVOLUNTARY, CONTINUOUS URINARY DRIBBLING. CURRENTLY, IT REFERS TO ANOTHER PRESENTATION OF URGE
INCONTINENCE.
OPTION B: URGE INCONTINENCE IS THE INVOLUNTARY ESCAPE OF URINE WHEN THERE IS AN IMMINENT NEED TO
URINATE. IT OCCURS DUE TO DETRUSOR MUSCLE OVERACTIVITY OR DETRUSOR INSTABILITY. IT IS SEEN MORE
COMMONLY IN OLD WOMEN WITH DECREASED BLADDER CAPACITY, DECREASED SENSATION, AND CNS
INHIBITION.
6060
OPTION D: NEUROGENIC BLADDER OCCURS IN PATIENTS WITH NEUROGENIC DYSFUNCTION LEADING TO DETRUSOR
HYPERREFLEXIA. CONDITIONS SUCH AS MULTIPLE SCLEROSIS, STROKE, PARKINSON'S DISEASE, AND SPINAL INJURY
GIVE RISE TO THIS. THEY PRESENT WITH URGENCY OR URGE INCONTINENCE.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt:
A 32-YEAR-OLD MARRIED WOMAN WHO CAME FOR THE EVALUATION OF INFERTILITY WAS FOUND TO HAVE A
SEPTUM IN HER UTERINE CAVITY. WHAT WOULD BE THE APPROPRIATE MANAGEMENT OF THIS CASE?
questions.explanation:
THE APPROPRIATE MANAGEMENT FOR A 32-YEAR-OLD WOMAN WITH A SEPTATE UTERUS IS HYSTEROSCOPY AND
SEPTOPLASTY.
HYSTEROSCOPIC SEPTOPLASTY REFERS TO THE RESECTION OF THE UTERINE SEPTUM
UNDER HYSTEROSCOPIC GUIDANCE. THE SEPTUM CAN BE RESECTED EITHER WITH A RESECTOSCOPE OR A LASER. IT
DOES NOT SCAR THE UTERUS AND AVOIDS THE NECESSITY OF CESAREAN SECTIONS FOR FUTURE PREGNANCIES.
THERE IS A REDUCED RISK OF PELVIC ADHESIONS, COMPARED WITH TRANSABDOMINAL APPROACHES.
A SEPTATE UTERUS IS CHARACTERIZED BY A SEPTUM IN THE ENDOMETRIAL CAVITY. IT IS CAUSED BY THE FAILURE
OF THE MEDIAL SEGMENTS OF THE MüLLERIAN DUCTS TO REGRESS. THIS CREATES A PERMANENT SEPTUM WITHIN
THE UTERINE CAVITY.
THE SEPTUM CAN PROJECT PARTIALLY FROM THE FUNDUS OR EXTEND COMPLETELY TO THE CERVICAL OS. IT IS THE
MOST COMMON CONGENITAL UTERINE MALFORMATION IN WOMEN WITH INFERTILITY.
OTHER OPTIONS:
OPTION A: HYSTERECTOMY IS NOT ADVISABLE SINCE THE PATIENT HAS COME FOR INFERTILITY EVALUATION AND
DESIRES PREGNANCY.
OPTIONS B & D: LAPAROSCOPY/LAPAROTOMY AND METROPLASTY ARE NOT PREFERRED FOR THE TREATMENT
OF A SEPTATE UTERUS DUE TO THE FOLLOWING:
- REQUIREMENT OF CESAREAN SECTION FOR SUBSEQUENT PREGNANCIES TO PREVENT UTERINE RUPTURE.
- POSTOPERATIVE PELVIC ADHESIONS LEADING TO INFERTILITY.
NOTE: JONE'S AND TOMPKIN'S METROPLASTIES ARE SURGERIES FOR THE SEPTATE UTERUS THAT INVOLVE A
TRANSABDOMINAL APPROACH. THEY CAUSE UTERINE SCARRING AND ARE HENCE NOT PREFERRED.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt:
A 30-YEAR-OLD G4A3 WOMAN HAD A HISTORY OF MISCARRIAGE AT 8 WEEKS, THE SECOND MISCARRIAGE
AT 11 WEEKS WITH NO CARDIAC ACTIVITY, AND THE THIRD PREGNANCY LOSS AT 24 WEEKS WITH PRETERM
DELIVERY DUE TO EARLY-ONSET PREECLAMPSIA. SPECIFY THE MOST PROBABLE DIAGNOSIS.
questions.explanation:
THE GIVEN CLINICAL SCENARIO OF A G4A3 WOMAN WITH MISCARRIAGES AT 8 AND 11 WEEKS, AND PRETERM
DELIVERY DUE TO PREECLAMPSIA AT 24 WEEKS IS SUGGESTIVE OF ANTIPHOSPHOLIPID ANTIBODY (APLA)
SYNDROME.
APLA IS AN AUTOIMMUNE DISORDER COMMONLY ASSOCIATED WITH FETAL DEATH, PRETERM DELIVERY,
EARLY-ONSET PREECLAMPSIA, AND FETAL GROWTH RESTRICTION DUE TO PLACENTAL INSUFFICIENCY AND
THROMBOSES. PREGNANCY LOSS USUALLY OCCURS BEFORE 10 WEEKS.
DIAGNOSIS OF APLA REQUIRES AT LEAST 1 CLINICAL CRITERION AND 1 LABORATORY CRITERION.
- OBSTETRIC CRITERIA
- ONE OR MORE UNEXPLAINED DEATHS OF A MORPHOLOGICALLY NORMAL FETUS AT OR BEYOND 10 WEEKS OR
- SEVERE PREECLAMPSIA OR PLACENTAL INSUFFICIENCY REQUIRING DELIVERY BEFORE 34 WEEKS, OR
6061
- THREE OR MORE UNEXPLAINED CONSECUTIVE SPONTANEOUS ABORTIONS BEFORE 10 WEEKS
- LABORATORY CRITERIA
- PRESENCE OF LUPUS ANTICOAGULANT, OR
- ANTICARDIOLIPIN ANTIBODIES, OR
- ANTI-β2 GLYCOPROTEIN ANTIBODY
RECURRENT PREGNANCY LOSS (RPL), ALSO REFERRED TO AS A RECURRENT MISCARRIAGE OR HABITUAL ABORTION,
IS HISTORICALLY DEFINED AS 3 CONSECUTIVE PREGNANCY LOSSES PRIOR TO 20 WEEKS FROM THE LAST MENSTRUAL
PERIOD.
COMMON CAUSES INCLUDE:
- PARENTAL CHROMOSOMAL ABNORMALITIES
- UNTREATED HYPOTHYROIDISM
- UNCONTROLLED DIABETES MELLITUS
- UTERINE ANATOMIC ABNORMALITIES,
- ANTIPHOSPHOLIPID ANTIBODY SYNDROME
OTHER OPTIONS:
OPTION A: THERE IS NO HISTORY OF STD OR SKIN LESIONS SUGGESTIVE OF SYPHILIS AND ACCORDING TO
KASSAWITZ RULE, IN WOMEN WITH UNTREATED SYPHILIS HAVING A SERIES OF PREGNANCIES, THE LIKELIHOOD OF
FETAL INFECTION IN LATER PREGNANCIES BECOMES LESS; USUALLY, ONLY THE FIRST PREGNANCY IS AN ABORTION,
THE FOLLOWING PREGNANCY LOSSES WILL BE STILLBIRTHS IN THE NEXT TRIMESTER RATHER THAN RECURRENT
PREGNANCY LOSS.
OPTION C: TORCH INFECTIONS MAY PLAY A ROLE IN SPORADIC SPONTANEOUS PREGNANCY LOSS, RATHER THAN
RECURRENT PREGNANCY LOSSES.
OPTION D: GESTATIONAL DIABETES MELLITUS (GDM) REFERS TO THE ONSET OR FIRST RECOGNITION OF DIABETES
DURING PREGNANCY, USUALLY AT THE 24-28 WEEKS SCREENING TEST. WOMEN WITH UNCONTROLLED OVERT OR
PREGESTATIONAL DIABETES WITH ELEVATED HBA1C OR PREPRANDIAL GLUCOSE IN THE FIRST TRIMESTER HAVE AN
INCREASED RISK FOR EARLY MISCARRIAGE, BUT THERE IS A HISTORY OR LAB FINDINGS SUGGESTIVE OF GESTATIONAL
DIABETES MELLITUS.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt:
A 26-YEAR-OLD FEMALE PATIENT CAME WITH A HISTORY OF FATIGUABILITY AND CONSTIPATION FOR THE PAST
1 YEAR. SHE HAS A HISTORY OF MULTIPLE BLOOD TRANSFUSIONS AFTER DELIVERY 4 YEARS AGO. SHE HAS HAD
A LACTATIONAL FAILURE AND NEVER REGAINED HER PERIODS AFTER THE DELIVERY. SPECIFY THE MOST
PROBABLE DIAGNOSIS.
questions.explanation:
THE MOST LIKELY DIAGNOSIS IN A WOMAN WITH LACTATIONAL FAILURE AND POSTPARTUM AMENORRHEA, NOW
PRESENTING WITH FATIGUABILITY AND CONSTIPATION IS SHEEHAN SYNDROME. A HISTORY OF MULTIPLE BLOOD
TRANSFUSIONS AFTER DELIVERY INDICATES MAJOR OBSTETRIC BLOOD LOSS, WHICH RESULTED IN PITUITARY
ISCHEMIA LEADING TO THIS CONDITION.
SHEEHAN SYNDROME IS PANHYPOPITUITARISM DUE TO PITUITARY ISCHEMIA AND NECROSIS FOLLOWING
MASSIVE OBSTETRICAL HEMORRHAGE.
THE MOST SEVERE FORM PRESENTS WITH SHOCK DUE TO PITUITARY APOPLEXY. IT IS CHARACTERIZED BY A
SUDDEN ONSET HEADACHE, NAUSEA, VISUAL DEFICITS, AND HORMONAL DYSFUNCTION DUE TO ACUTE PITUITARY
HEMORRHAGE OR INFARCTION. LESS SEVERE FORMS PRESENT WITH ANOVULATION AND AMENORRHEA.
6062
DAMAGE TO SPECIFIC PITUITARY CELL TYPES LEADS TO LACTATIONAL FAILURE, LOSS OF AXILLARY AND PUBIC HAIR,
AND SYMPTOMS OF HYPOTHYROIDISM OR ADRENAL INSUFFICIENCY. PROLACTIN DEFICIENCY IS MOST COMMONLY
ENCOUNTERED, BUT ADRENAL INSUFFICIENCY IS THE MOST LIFE-THREATENING COMPLICATION. HENCE, THE
ADRENAL FUNCTION SHOULD BE IMMEDIATELY ASSESSED IF THERE IS ANY SUSPICION OF SHEEHAN SYNDROME.
OPTION B: HYPOTHYROIDISM CAN PRESENT WITH VAGUE SYMPTOMS SUCH AS FATIGUE, CONSTIPATION, AND
AMENORRHEA. HOWEVER, POSTPARTUM HYPOTHYROIDISM USUALLY PRESENTS 4-8 MONTHS AFTER DELIVERY
AFTER A THYROTOXIC PHASE WITH PALPITATIONS AND THYROID ENLARGEMENT.
OPTION C: PREMATURE OVARIAN FAILURE PRESENTS WITH MENOPAUSAL SYMPTOMS. IT IS DUE TO PRIMARY
OVARIAN DYSFUNCTION. IT IS DIAGNOSED WHEN SERUM FSH LEVELS ARE >30-40 MIU/ML ON TWO
OCCASIONS, AT LEAST ONE MONTH APART.
OPTION D: DELAYED TRANSFUSION REACTION PRESENTS DAYS TO WEEKS AFTER THE TRANSFUSION. IT MAY BE
ASYMPTOMATIC OR WITH LOW-GRADE FEVER. COOMBS TEST MAY BE POSITIVE, UNCONJUGATED BILIRUBIN
INCREASED, AND THE RISE IN HEMOGLOBIN LEVELS FOLLOWING THE TRANSFUSION WILL BE LESS THAN EXPECTED.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt: THE ULTRASOUND OF A YOUNG WOMAN WITH INFERTILITY IS SUGGESTIVE OF A UTERINE ANOMALY. WHICH OF THESE IS USED TO CONFIRM THE DIAGNOSIS?
questions.explanation:
AMONG THE GIVEN OPTIONS, HYSTEROSCOPY WITH LAPAROSCOPY IS USED TO CONFIRM THE DIAGNOSIS.
FOR INFERTILITY EVALUATION, HYSTEROSCOPY AND LAPAROSCOPY CAN DETECT MüLLERIAN ANOMALIES, SCREEN
FOR CO-EXISTENT ENDOMETRIOSIS, AND EXCLUDE OTHER TUBAL OR UTERINE CAVITY PATHOLOGY.
THIS APPROACH CAN DIFFERENTIATE BETWEEN A SEPTATE AND A BICORNUATE UTERUS. ON LAPAROSCOPY, THE
PRESENCE OF A UTERINE FUNDUS INDICATES THAT THE UTERUS IS SEPTATE, WHILE ITS ABSENCE INDICATES IT IS
BICORNUATE. THE CAPACITY OF EACH HORN IN A BICORNUATE UTERUS AND THE DEPTH AND THICKNESS OF THE
UTERINE SEPTUM PRIOR TO SURGICAL RESECTION CAN ALSO BE ASSESSED.
MRI IS THE GOLD STANDARD INVESTIGATION FOR THE DIAGNOSIS OF MULLERIAN ANOMALIES. IT CLEARLY
DELINEATES BOTH THE INTERNAL AND EXTERNAL UTERINE ANATOMY. COMPLEX ANOMALIES AND COMMON
ASSOCIATIONS LIKE RENAL OR SKELETAL ANOMALIES CAN ALSO BE EVALUATED. IT IS ALSO LESS INVASIVE THAN
HYSTEROSCOPY AND LAPAROSCOPY IN DIAGNOSING MULLERIAN ANOMALIES.
OTHER OPTIONS:
OPTION A: HYSTEROSALPINGOGRAPHY (HSG) PROVIDES INFORMATION ABOUT THE INTERIOR CONTOUR OF THE
UTERINE CAVITY BUT CANNOT ACCURATELY VISUALIZE THE EXTERNAL CONTOUR OF THE UTERUS.
OPTION C: LAPAROSCOPY ALONE AS A DIAGNOSTIC PROCEDURE CANNOT VISUALIZE THE INTERIOR CONTOUR OF A
HOLLOW VISCUS LIKE THE UTERUS. THIS CAN BE DONE ONLY WITH THE HELP OF HYSTEROSCOPY OR IMAGING SUCH
AS SONOGRAPHY, HSG, OR MRI.
OPTION D: TRANSVAGINAL SONOGRAPHY IS USED FOR THE INITIAL DETECTION OF UTERINE ANOMALIES CAUSING
INFERTILITY OR SPONTANEOUS ABORTIONS. COMPLETE EVALUATION OF THESE ANOMALIES IS DONE BY MRI.
NOTE:
- HYSTEROSCOPY IS THE GOLD STANDARD INVESTIGATION TO VISUALIZE THE UTERINE CAVITY AND TUBAL OSTIA. IT
ALSO HAS THERAPEUTIC BENEFITS IN CASES OF ENDOMETRIAL POLYPS, SUBMUCOUS RESECTION OF MYOMA,
HYSTEROSCOPIC ADHESIOLYSIS, AND RESECTION OF UTERINE SEPTUM.
- LAPAROSCOPY IS THE GOLD STANDARD INVESTIGATION TO EVALUATE TUBAL FACTORS OF INFERTILITY.
6063

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt:
A 26-YEAR-OLD PREGNANT WOMAN, UPON EXAMINATION WAS FOUND TO HAVE INFRA-UMBILICAL FLATTENING.
THE FETAL HEART SOUNDS WERE HEARD OVER THE LATERAL SIDE. WHAT COULD BE THE FETAL
PRESENTATION/POSITION?
questions.explanation:
THE PRESENCE OF INFRA-UMBILICAL FLATTENING AND FETAL HEART SOUNDS ON THE LATERAL SIDE INDICATES THAT
THE FETUS IS IN THE OCCIPITO-POSTERIOR POSITION.
OCCIPITO-POSTERIOR (OP) POSITION OF THE FETUS IS WHEN THE OCCIPUT IS SITUATED POSTERIORLY OVER THE
SACROILIAC JOINT, OR DIRECTLY OVER THE SACRUM. THE FETUS IS IN VERTEX PRESENTATION.
EXAMINATION FINDINGS OF OP POSITION:
- ON INSPECTION, THE ABDOMEN APPEARS FLATTENED BELOW THE UMBILICUS (INFRA-UMBILICAL FLATTENING).
- PELVIC GRIPS:
- THE HEAD IS NOT ENGAGED.
- THE SINCIPUT (CEPHALIC PROMINENCE) IS NOT PROMINENTLY FELT.
- AUSCULTATION: FETAL HEART SOUNDS ARE HEARD MAXIMALLY OVER THE FLANKS. HOWEVER, IN THE DIRECT OP
POSITION, THEY ARE HEARD IN THE MIDLINE.
THERE ARE THREE VARIANTS OF OP POSITION:
- LEFT OP POSITION (FOURTH POSITION OF THE VERTEX) - WHEN THE OCCIPUT POINTS TOWARDS THE LEFT
SACROILIAC JOINT.
- RIGHT OP POSITION (THIRD POSITION OF THE VERTEX) - WHEN THE OCCIPUT POINTS TOWARDS THE RIGHT
SACROILIAC JOINT. IT IS MORE COMMON THAN THE LEFT OP POSITION.
- DIRECT OP POSITION - WHEN THE OCCIPUT POINTS DIRECTLY TOWARDS THE SACRUM.
ALL THREE POSITIONS MAY BE PRIMARY (PRESENT BEFORE THE ONSET OF LABOR) OR SECONDARY (DEVELOPS AFTER
THE ONSET OF LABOR).
OTHER OPTIONS:
OPTION A: BROW PRESENTATION IS A RARE TYPE OF CEPHALIC PRESENTATION WHERE THE POSITION OF THE HEAD
IS IN BETWEEN FULL FLEXION AND FULL EXTENSION. THE PART OF THE HEAD BETWEEN THE ORBITAL RIDGE AND THE
ANTERIOR FONTANEL PRESENTS AT THE PELVIC INLET.
OPTION B: KNEE PRESENTATION IS A TYPE OF BREECH PRESENTATION. HERE, THE THIGHS ARE EXTENDED BUT
THE KNEES ARE FLEXED, PRESENTING AT THE PELVIC INLET. THE HEAD WILL BE PALPABLE AS A HARD GLOBULAR
MASS AT THE FUNDUS.
OPTION D: RIGHT DORSO-ANTERIOR POSITION IS WHEN THE FETAL BACK IS DIRECTED ANTERIORLY. THIS OCCURS
IN A TRANSVERSE LIE. ON EXAMINATION, THE ABDOMEN APPEARS WIDE, AND A HARD PLANE OF RESISTANCE IS
FELT. THE FUNDUS EXTENDS JUST ABOVE THE UMBILICUS. THE HEAD IS FELT IN ONE ILIAC FOSSA AND THE BREECH
IS FELT IN THE OTHER.
6064

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt:
A PRIMI AT TERM PRESENTED WITH LABOR PAIN AND MULTIPLE PAINFUL VESICULAR LESIONS ON HER VULVA.
NO RASHES WERE FOUND ON OTHER PARTS OF THE BODY. WHAT WILL BE THE MANAGEMENT OF THIS CASE?
questions.explanation:
THE GIVEN CLINICAL SCENARIO OF A PRIMI IN LABOR PAIN WITH MULTIPLE, PAINFUL VESICULAR LESIONS ON HER
VULVA IS SUGGESTIVE OF AN ACTIVE HERPES SIMPLEX VIRUS (HSV) INFECTION. MANAGEMENT INVOLVES THE
ADMINISTRATION OF ACYCLOVIR AND ELECTIVE CESAREAN SECTION.
HSV INFECTION IN PREGNANCY CAN BE CAUSED BY EITHER HSV-1 OR HSV-2 AND TRANSMITTED BY SEXUAL
CONTACT. THE INFECTION CAN BE PRIMARY, NONPRIMARY, FIRST EPISODE, AND RECURRENT.
HSV INFECTION (BOTH HSV 1 AND 2) DURING PREGNANCY HAS A RISK OF VERTICAL TRANSMISSION OF THE
INFECTION TO THE FETUS. THE RISK IS HIGHER IN THE PRIMARY THAN IN THE RECURRENT INFECTION. THE
MAXIMUM RISK OF FETAL INFECTION IS DURING LABOR, ALTHOUGH IT CAN OCCUR IN UTERO AND POST-NATALLY
FROM DIRECT CONTACT.
6065
SUSPICIOUS LESIONS SHOULD BE SENT FOR PCR TESTING OR CULTURE. ANTIVIRAL TREATMENT WITH ACYCLOVIR
SHOULD BE GIVEN IF FOUND POSITIVE. WOMEN WITH NO ACTIVE GENITAL LESIONS, ASYMPTOMATIC, OR THOSE
WITH ACTIVE LESIONS IN NON-GENITAL AREAS CAN UNDERGO NORMAL LABOR AND DELIVERY.
MANAGEMENT OF HSV INFECTION DURING PREGNANCY:
- ORAL ACYCLOVIR OR VALACYCLOVIR FOR PRIMARY OR RECURRENT INFECTIONS DURING PREGNANCY.
- IV ACYCLOVIR FOLLOWED BY ORAL ACYCLOVIR FOR SEVERE OR DISSEMINATED INFECTION
- ORAL ANALGESICS OR TOPICAL ANESTHETICS FOR PAIN RELIEF
- CATHETERIZATION FOR URINARY RETENTION
CESAREAN DELIVERY REDUCES THE RISK OF VERTICAL TRANSMISSION DURING LABOR AND IS INDICATED IN:
- CASES OF ACTIVE GENITAL LESIONS - BOTH PRIMARY AND RECURRENT
- PRODROMAL SYMPTOMS LIKE VULVAL ITCHING OR BURNING
OTHER OPTIONS:
OPTION B: THE PRESENE OF ACTIVE LESIONS IS A CONTRAINDICATION FOR INDUCTION OF LABOR.
OPTION C: SPONTANEOUS DELIVERY IS CONTRAINDICATED IN THE PRESENCE OF ACTIVE LESIONS.
OPTION D: EVEN AFTER TREATMENT WITH ACYCLOVIR, NORMAL DELIVERY IS NOT INDICATED OWING TO THE RISK
OF DORMANT VIRAL TRANSMISSION TO THE FETUS.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt:
A 30-YEAR-OLD MARRIED WOMAN CAME FOR AN INFERTILITY EVALUATION. ON PERFORMING FURTHER
INVESTIGATIONS, INTRAMURAL FIBROIDS OF SIZES 7X5CM AND 5X3CM WERE SEEN AT THE RIGHT AND LEFT
CORNUAL ENDS OF THE UTERUS. HER HUSBAND'S SEMEN ANALYSIS WAS FOUND TO BE NORMAL. SPECIFY THE APPROPRIATE MANAGEMENT OF THIS CASE.
questions.explanation:
THE MOST APPROPRIATE MANAGEMENT FOR A WOMAN WITH INFERTILITY DUE TO INTRAMURAL FIBROIDS AT BOTH
THE CORNUAL ENDS OF THE UTERUS IS MYOMECTOMY. THE INFERTILITY, IN THIS CASE, IS DUE TO THE FIBROIDS
BLOCKING THE RIGHT AND LEFT CORNUA OF THE UTERUS.
MYOMECTOMY REFERS TO THE REMOVAL OF FIBROIDS AND PRESERVING THE UTERUS. IT IS INDICATED IN WOMEN
PRESENTING WITH INFERTILITY, THOSE WHO DESIRE PREGNANCY, OR THOSE WHO WISH TO RETAIN THE UTERUS.
INTRACAVITARY FIBROIDS CAN BE RESECTED VIA THE HYSTEROSCOPIC APPROACH, WHILE SUBSEROSAL OR
INTRAMURAL FIBROIDS REQUIRE LAPAROTOMY OR LAPAROSCOPIC MYOMECTOMY.
OTHER OPTIONS:
OPTION A: UTERINE ARTERY EMBOLIZATION IS NOT DONE IN THIS CASE, AS IT MAY DECREASE FERTILITY, AS A
RESULT OF PELVIC ADHESIONS. IT IS A TECHNIQUE IN WHICH POLYVINYL ALCOHOL (PVA), GEL FOAM PARTICLES, OR
METAL COILS ARE INJECTED INTO THE UTERINE ARTERIES. THIS EMBOLIZATION REDUCES VASCULARITY AND THE
SIZE OF THE FIBROID. IT IS BEST SUITED TO CONTROL MENORRHAGIA IN MULTIPAROUS WOMEN.
OPTION C: ARTIFICIAL REPRODUCTIVE TECHNIQUES ARE NOT INDICATED IN THIS CASE AS INFERTILITY IS SEEN TO
BE DUE TO THE FIBROIDS BLOCKING THE CORNUAL ENDS OF THE UTERUS. HOWEVER, IT MAY BE CONSIDERED AT A
LATER STAGE.
OPTION D: GNRH ANALOGS WHEN USED FOR 6 MONTHS, CAN REDUCE THE TUMOR SIZE BY TARGETING THE
GROWTH EFFECTS OF ESTROGEN AND PROGESTERONE. IT CAN BE USED IN WOMEN WITH INFERTILITY CAUSED BY
CORNUAL FIBROIDS. THEY ARE OFTEN USED PREOPERATIVELY TO REDUCE THE SIZE OF THE FIBROID AND FACILITATE
A HYSTEROSCOPIC APPROACH TO SURGERY. HOWEVER, IT IS EXPENSIVE AND CAN CAUSE MENOPAUSAL
SYMPTOMS IF USED FOR >6 MONTHS. FIBROIDS ARE KNOWN TO REGROW 3-4 MONTHS AFTER STOPPING THE
6066
THERAPY.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt:
A 28-YEAR-OLD MARRIED WOMAN WHO IS ANXIOUS TO CONCEIVE PRESENTS WITH COPIOUS VAGINAL
DISCHARGE, WITHOUT ANY ITCHING. HER LAST MENSTRUAL PERIOD WAS 13 DAYS AGO. SPECIFY THE CAUSE
OF HER VAGINAL DISCHARGE.
questions.explanation:
THE GIVEN CLINICAL SCENARIO OF A YOUNG WOMAN WITH COPIOUS, NON-PRURITIC (WITHOUT ITCHING) VAGINAL
DISCHARGE OCCURRING 13 DAYS AFTER MENSTRUAL PERIOD (PERIOD OF OVULATION) IS MOST LIKELY TO BE
LEUCORRHOEA (PHYSIOLOGICAL).
THE TERM LEUCORRHOEA CAN BE USED IN CONDITIONS WHERE NORMAL VAGINAL SECRETION IS INCREASED IN
AMOUNT. AN INCREASE IN THIS NORMAL VAGINAL SECRETION DEVELOPS PHYSIOLOGICALLY:
- AT PUBERTY
- AT OVULATION
- DURING PREGNANCY
- DURING THE PREMENSTRUAL PHASE, OCCASIONALLY
IT MAY BE CERVICAL OR VAGINAL IN ORIGIN. A SPECULUM EXAMINATION OF THE VAGINA CAN DISTINGUISH
BETWEEN THE TWO. IF THE DISCHARGE IS CERVICAL IN ORIGIN, AN EXCESSIVE MUCOID DISCHARGE WILL BE
VISIBLE AT THE EXTERNAL OS.
NORMAL DISCHARGE APPEARS CLEAR OR WHITE, WITHOUT ANY ODOR OR ITCHING, AND WILL HAVE A PH OF
3.8-4.2.
OTHER OPTIONS:
OPTION A: CANDIDIASIS IS CAUSED BY INFECTION WITH CANDIDA ALBICANS AND PRESENTS WITH PRURITUS,
BURNING, AND DYSURIA WITH VULVAR ERYTHEMA, EDEMA, AND EXCORIATIONS. A CURDY WHITE DISCHARGE WILL
BE PRESENT.
OPTION B: BACTERIAL VAGINOSIS IS CAUSED BY AN ALTERATION IN THE NORMAL VAGINAL FLORA AND
PRESENTS WITHOUT ITCHING AND A MALODOROUS GREY-WHITE DISCHARGE. IT IS DIAGNOSED USING AMSEL'S
CRITERIA, WHERE AT LEAST THREE OF THE FOUR FOLLOWING CRITERIA SHOULD BE PRESENT TO CONFIRM THE
DIAGNOSIS:
- HOMOGENOUS VAGINAL DISCHARGE
- VAGINAL PH > 4.5
- AMINE-LIKE ODOR ON ADDING KOH (WHIFF TEST POSITIVE)
- CLUE CELLS (>20% OF CELLS)
OPTION C: TRICHOMONIASIS IS CAUSED BY TRICHOMONAS VAGINALIS AND PRESENTS WITH A COPIOUS, FROTHY,
OFFENSIVE YELLOW-GREEN DISCHARGE WITH VAGINAL SORENESS OR IRRITATION AND URINARY FREQUENCY. ON
EXAMINATION, THE VAGINA LOOKS RED AND INFLAMED. THE INFLAMED CERVIX LOOKS LIKE A STRAWBERRY WITH
PUNCTATE HEMORRHAGIC SPOTS.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt:
A PATIENT DEVELOPED ATONIC POSTPARTUM HEMORRHAGE AFTER A NORMAL VAGINAL DELIVERY. SHE WAS
SHIFTED TO THE OT AND THE OBSTETRICIAN PLANNED LIGATION OF VESSELS TO ARREST THE BLEEDING. SPECIFY THE ORDER OF LIGATION OF THE BLOOD VESSELS SUPPLYING THE UTERUS.
options: UTERINE ARTERY - OVARIAN ARTERY - INTERNAL ILIAC ARTERY
UTERINE ARTERY - OVARIAN ARTERY- EXTERNAL ILIAC ARTERY
UTERINE ARTERY - OVARIAN ARTERY - VAGINAL ARTERY
UTERINE ARTERY - PUDENDAL ARTERY - VAGINAL ARTERY
questions.answer: UTERINE ARTERY - OVARIAN ARTERY - INTERNAL ILIAC ARTERY
questions.explanation:
6067
THE ORDER OF LIGATION OF VESSELS TO ARREST BLEEDING IN ATONIC POSTPARTUM HEMORRHAGE (PPH) IS THE
UTERINE ARTERY - OVARIAN ARTERY - INTERNAL ILIAC ARTERY.
THE ASCENDING BRANCH OF THE UTERINE ARTERY IS LIGATED BETWEEN THE UPPER AND LOWER SEGMENTS OF THE
UTERUS, AT THE LATERAL BORDER. IF THE BLEEDING CONTINUES, THE OVARIAN AND UTERINE ARTERY ANASTOMOSIS
IS LIGATED JUST BELOW THE OVARIAN LIGAMENT. IF THE BLEEDING STILL PERSISTS, THE ANTERIOR DIVISION OF THE
INTERNAL ILIAC ARTERY IS LIGATED 5 CM DISTAL TO THE COMMON ILIAC BIFURCATION.
UNILATERAL OR BILATERAL LIGATION OF THE INTERNAL ILIAC ARTERY LIGATION CAUSES A REDUCTION IN THE PULSE
PRESSURE IN THE ARTERIES DISTAL TO THE LIGATION. THIS INCREASES THE CHANCES OF HEMOSTASIS VIA PRESSURE
AND CLOT FORMATION.
SURGICAL METHODS TO CONTROL PPH ARE OUTLINED AS STEPWISE UTERINE DEVASCULARIZATION PROCEDURES:
- COMPRESSION SUTURES: B-LYNCH SUTURE
- LIGATION OF UTERINE ARTERIES
- LIGATION OF OVARIAN AND UTERINE ANASTOMOSIS
- LIGATION OF INTERNAL ILIAC ARTERY
- ANGIOGRAPHIC EMBOLIZATION OF THE BLEEDING VESSEL
PELVIC PACKING (USUALLY DONE PRIOR TO EMBOLIZATION) AND HYSTERECTOMY ARE OTHER SURGICAL METHODS
EMPLOYED TO CONTROL PPH.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt:
A TEENAGE PATIENT PRESENTED WITH A HISTORY OF DYSMENORRHEA AND CHRONIC PELVIC PAIN. ON
ULTRASONOGRAPHY, A TRANSVERSE VAGINAL SEPTUM WAS SEEN. SPECIFY THE MOST COMMON
COMPLICATION THAT CAN BE SEEN IN THE PATIENT DESCRIBED.
questions.explanation:
THE MOST COMMON COMPLICATION THAT CAN BE SEEN IN THIS PATIENT IS ENDOMETRIOSIS.
TRANSVERSE VAGINAL SEPTUM LEADS TO OBSTRUCTED FLOW OF MENSTRUAL BLOOD. THIS MAY LEAD TO
RETROGRADE MENSTRUATION, WHICH INCREASES THE LIKELIHOOD OF THE DEVELOPMENT OF ENDOMETRIOSIS,
ACCORDING TO SAMPSON'S THEORY OF ENDOMETRIOSIS.
6068
TRANSVERSE VAGINAL SEPTUM OCCURS AS A RESULT OF THE FAILURE OF MüLLERIAN DUCT FUSION OR FAILURE
OF VAGINAL PLATE CANALIZATION. IT MAY BE OBSTRUCTIVE OR NON-OBSTRUCTIVE. THE COMMONEST SITE OF A
TRANSVERSE SEPTUM IS THE JUNCTION BETWEEN THE UPPER AND MIDDLE THIRD OF THE VAGINA.
PATIENTS WITH AN OBSTRUCTIVE OR IMPERFORATE VAGINAL SEPTUM PRESENT WITH SYMPTOMS SIMILAR TO THE
IMPERFORATE HYMEN. SYMPTOMS INCLUDE AMENORRHOEA, CYCLICAL ABDOMINAL PAIN, URINARY SYMPTOMS,
AND A PALPABLE PELVIC MASS. THE VAGINA MAY APPEAR SHORTENED AND THE CERVIX MAY NOT BE
IDENTIFIABLE. SECONDARY SEXUAL CHARACTERISTICS APPEAR NORMAL. THE DIAGNOSIS CAN BE CONFIRMED WITH
ULTRASOUND OR MRI.
THERE IS AN INCREASED RISK OF ENDOMETRIOSIS. OTHER COMPLICATIONS SUCH AS PYOMUCOCOLPOS,
PYOMETRA, AND PYOSALPINGES CAN ALSO DEVELOP IN INFANTS WITH OBSTRUCTIVE VAGINAL SEPTUMS.
TREATMENT IS BY MANUAL DILATATION OF THE PERFORATION OR SURGICAL EXCISION OF THE SEPTUM.
OTHER OPTIONS:
OPTION B: TUBO-OVARIAN ABSCESS DEVELOPS IN PELVIC INFLAMMATORY DISEASE.
OPTION C: DERMOID CYSTS ARE CYSTIC OVARIAN TUMORS THAT ARE OFTEN ASSOCIATED WITH MUCINOUS
CYSTADENOMAS.
OPTION D: THECA LUTEIN CYSTS ARE FOUND IN ASSOCIATION WITH HYDATIDIFORM MOLES, CHORIOCARCINOMA,
AND GONADOTROPIN OR CLOMIPHENE CITRATE THERAPY. THEY REGRESS WITH THE MANAGEMENT OF THE MOLE
AND CHORIOCARCINOMA AND DISCONTINUATION OF GONADOTROPIN THERAPY.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt:
A 28-YEAR OLD PREGNANT WOMAN CAME FOR A ROUTINE ANTENATAL CHECK-UP IN HER SECOND
TRIMESTER. FOUR YEARS BACK, SHE DELIVERED 2 HEALTHY FULL-TERM TWINS. WHAT WOULD HER OBSTETRIC
SCORE BE?
questions.explanation:
THE OBSTETRIC SCORE OF A PREGNANT WOMAN WHO PREVIOUSLY DELIVERED TWINS WOULD BE G2P1 (GRAVIDA
2 PARA 1).
THE TERM GRAVIDA REFERS TO THE NUMBER OF TIMES THE WOMAN HAS BEEN PREGNANT, IRRESPECTIVE OF
WHETHER IT CROSSED THE PERIOD OF VIABILITY. THE CURRENT PREGNANCY IS INCLUDED IN THIS COUNT. SINCE
SHE HAS BEEN PREGNANT ONCE BEFORE WITH TWINS AND IS CURRENTLY PREGNANT NOW, GRAVIDA WILL BE 2.
THE TERM PARA REFERS TO THE NUMBER OF PREVIOUS PREGNANCIES REACHING A PERIOD OF VIABILITY
(GESTATION OF 28 WEEKS). IT DOES NOT INCREASE TO A HIGHER NUMBER IF MULTIPLES (TWINS/TRIPLETS) ARE
DELIVERED IN A GIVEN PREGNANCY AND STILL COUNT AS ONE BIRTH. A CURRENT PREGNANCY, IF ANY, IS NOT
INCLUDED IN THIS COUNT. THEREFORE, PARA HERE WILL BE 1 SINCE SHE HAD ONE BIRTH OF TWINS AND THE
PRESENT PREGNANCY IS NOT COUNTED.
BOTH GRAVIDITY AND PARITY REFER TO THE PREGNANCIES AND NOT THE FETUSES.
NOTE: THE PERIOD OF VIABILITY IS WHEN THE FETUS IS CAPABLE OF INDEPENDENT EXISTENCE. THE WHO
DEFINES IT TO BE 24 WEEKS WHILE THE INDIAN DEFINITION IS 28 WEEKS.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt:
A 27-YEAR-OLD WOMAN WHO IS ON ORAL CONTRACEPTIVE PILLS FOR CONTRACEPTION HAS FORGOTTEN TO
TAKE HER PILLS ON 4 DIFFERENT DAYS IN THE LAST 2 WEEKS. SHE PRESENTS TO THE PRIMARY HEALTH
CENTER, ASKING FOR ADVICE. WHAT WOULD YOU SUGGEST TO HER?
options: TAKE 4 PILLS NOW, CONTINUE THE SCHEDULE, USE BARRIER METHOD OF CONTRACEPTION
TAKE 1 PILL NOW, CONTINUE THE SCHEDULE, AND USE BARRIER METHOD OF CONTRACEPTION

TAKE 1 PILL NOW, USE BARRIER METHOD, AND CONSIDER EMERGENCY CONTRACEPTION IN CASE OF RECENT
INTERCOURSE
DISCARD THE PACK, START A NEW PACK WITH ALTERNATE METHOD OF CONTRACEPTION
questions.answer: DISCARD THE PACK, START A NEW PACK WITH ALTERNATE METHOD OF CONTRACEPTION
questions.explanation:
A WOMAN WHO HAS MISSED 4 ORAL CONTRACEPTIVE PILLS IN THE LAST TWO WEEKS SHOULD TAKE ONE
HORMONAL PILL AS SOON AS POSSIBLE AND FINISH ALL HORMONAL PILLS IN THE PACK AS SCHEDULED, THROW
AWAY THE 7 NON-HORMONAL PILLS IN A 28-PILL PACK AND START A NEW PACK THE NEXT DAY.
6069
IF ANY NON-HORMONAL PILLS WERE MISSED, SHE CAN DISCARD THE REMAINING PILLS. START THE NEW PACK OF
ORAL CONTRACEPTIVES AND CONTINUE TAKING AS USUAL.
IF SHE VOMITS WITHIN 2 HOURS OF TAKING A PILL, ANOTHER PILL FROM THE PACK SHOULD BE TAKEN AS SOON AS
POSSIBLE. AFTER THAT, CONTINUE TAKING THE PILLS AS SCHEDULED. IF THE VOMITING OR DIARRHEA PERSISTS FOR
>2 DAYS, FOLLOW THE INSTRUCTIONS FOR 1 OR 2 MISSED PILLS AS MENTIONED ABOVE.
THE CONTRACEPTIVE METHOD SHOULD BE DISCONTINUED AND CHANGED IN THE FOLLOWING SITUATIONS:
- UNEXPLAINED OR PROLONGED HEAVY VAGINAL BLEEDING THAT SUGGESTS AN UNDERLYING CONDITION NOT
RELATED TO THE METHOD
- STARTING ANTICONVULSANT MEDICATION OR TREATMENT WITH RIFAMPICIN
- MIGRAINES
- NON-AMBULATORY CONDITIONS LASTING FOR >1 WEEK LIKE MAJOR SURGERY, LEG IN A CAST, ETC. COMBINED
ORAL CONTRACEPTIVES CAN BE RESTARTED 2 WEEKS AFTER AMBULATION.
- SUSPECTED HEART OR LIVER DISEASE, HYPERTENSION, DEEP VEIN THROMBOSIS, STROKE, BREAST CANCER,
DIABETES, OR GALL BLADDER DISEASE

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt: A 30 year old female patient, on treatment for infertility, came with 6 weeks of amenorrhea, abdominal pain, and mild vaginal bleeding. Her beta hCG level was 2800 mIU/mL. On ultrasound, a 3cm mass was seen in the left adnexa. It contained a gestational sac with no fetal cardiac activity. Specify the most appropriate management for this patient . hCG- Human Chronic Gonadotropin
questions.explanation:
A PATIENT ON INFERTILITY TREATMENT, WITH 6 WEEKS OF AMENORRHEA, ABDOMINAL PAIN, AND VAGINAL
BLEEDING WITH BETA HCG LEVELS OF 2800 MIU/ML, AND A GESTATIONAL SAC IN THE LEFT ADNEXA POINTS TO
THE DIAGNOSIS OF UNRUPTURED ECTOPIC PREGNANCY AND THE MOST APPROPRIATE MANAGEMENT IS
SINGLE-DOSE METHOTREXATE.
A PREGNANCY IS CONSIDERED ECTOPIC IF IMPLANTATION OCCURS AT A SITE OUTSIDE THE UTERINE CAVITY. THE
MAJORITY OF ECTOPIC PREGNANCIES OCCUR IN THE FALLOPIAN TUBE, THE AMPULLA BEING THE MOST COMMON
SITE.
MANAGEMENT OF ECTOPIC PREGNANCY:
EXPECTANT MANAGEMENT: ECTOPIC PREGNANCIES MEASURING <3 CM AND WITH DECLINING BETA HCG
LEVELS INITIALLY <1500 MIU/ML MAY RESOLVE WITHOUT INTERVENTION AND CAN BE MANAGED
EXPECTANTLY.
MEDICAL MANAGEMENT WITH SINGLE OR MULTIPLE-DOSE METHOTREXATE IS PREFERRED IF:
- HEMODYNAMIC STABILITY
- SERUM BETA-HCG ≥1500 MIU/ML AND ≤5000 MIU/ML
- MEAN SAC DIAMETER <3.5CM WITH NO FETAL CARDIAC ACTIVITY DETECTED ON TRANSVAGINAL ULTRASOUND.
- PATIENTS ARE WILLING AND ABLE TO COMPLY WITH POST-TREATMENT FOLLOW-UP AND HAVE ACCESS TO
EMERGENCY MEDICAL SERVICES WITHIN A REASONABLE TIME FRAME IN CASE OF A DETERIORATION IN THE
CLINICAL STATUS.
METHOTREXATE(MTX) CAN BE GIVEN AS A SINGLE IM DOSE OF 50 MG/M2 OR AS A MULTIPLE-DOSE REGIMEN
OF 1MG/KG ON DAYS 1, 3, 5, AND 7.
SURGICAL MANAGEMENT WITH SALPINGECTOMY OR SALPINGOSTOMY IS DONE WHEN:
- CRITERIA FOR EXPECTANT AND MEDICAL MANAGEMENT ARE NOT MET
- GESTATIONAL SAC >3.5 CM
- FETAL CARDIAC ACTIVITY PRESENT
- BETA HCG > 5000 MIU/ML
- SIGNIFICANT PAIN AND HEMOPERITONEUM
- FAILURE OF EXPECTANT OR MEDICAL MANAGEMENT
- CLINICAL STATUS OF PATIENT WARRANTS URGENT INTERVENTION
- DOUBTFUL COMPLIANCE WITH MEDICAL MANAGEMENT
MILKING OF THE TUBE THROUGH THE FIMBRIAE CARRIES A HIGH RISK OF BLEEDING, DAMAGE TO THE TUBE, THE
PERSISTENCE OF TROPHOBLASTIC TISSUE, AND RECURRENCE OF ECTOPIC PREGNANCY.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt: A 30 year old woman on oral contraceptives for the past 6 months presents with 6 weeks of amenorrhea. What would be the best method of assessing the gestational age of this patient ? LMP- Last Menstrual Period USG- Ultrasonography
questions.explanation:
THE BEST METHOD OF ASSESSING THE GESTATIONAL AGE OF A PATIENT ON ORAL CONTRACEPTIVES WITH 6 WEEKS
OF AMENORRHEA IS BY MEASURING THE CROWN-RUMP LENGTH (CRL) USING ULTRASONOGRAPHY.
6071
GESTATIONAL AGE REFERS TO THE DURATION OF PREGNANCY CALCULATED FROM THE FIRST DAY OF THE LMP. IT IS
USUALLY EXPRESSED IN WEEKS. FOLLOWING THE USE OF ORAL CONTRACEPTIVES, OVULATION MAY HAVE BEEN
LATER THAN 2 WEEKS AFTER THE LMP. THEREFORE, GESTATIONAL AGE CALCULATED WITH THE HELP OF LMP
WILL BE INACCURATE.
FIRST-TRIMESTER ULTRASOUND MEASUREMENT OF CRL IS THE BEST METHOD TO ASSESS GESTATIONAL AGE. IT IS
MEASURED FROM THE VERTEX TO THE COCCYX.
- CRL (IN MM) + 6.5 = GESTATIONAL AGE IN WEEKS (OR)
- CRL (IN MM) + 42 DAYS = GESTATIONAL AGE IN DAYS.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt:
A 25-YEAR-OLD LADY HAD AN UNEVENTFUL VAGINAL DELIVERY. ON POSTPARTUM DAY 1, SHE PRESENTED
WITH POSTPARTUM HAEMORRHAGE AND REPORTS VISUAL CHANGES AND SEVERE HEADACHE. A FEW
HOURS AFTER THE COMPLAINT, SHE IS FOUND TO BE IN AN UNRESPONSIVE STATE AND IS INTUBATED AND
PUT ON VENTILATION. ON FURTHER EXAMINATION, SHE HAS A BP OF 60/40 MMHG AND TACHYCARDIA,
BLOOD SUGAR IS 48 MG/DL. HEMATOCRIT AND WBC COUNT WAS NORMAL. WHICH OF THESE
DRUGS WOULD HELP REVERSE THIS STATE?
questions.explanation:
THE GIVEN HISTORY OF A PREGNANT HAVING POSTPARTUM HEMORRHAGE DEVELOPING HEADACHE, VISUAL
CHANGES, AND HYPOTENSION AFTER A VAGINAL DELIVERY SUGGESTS SHEEHAN SYNDROME. STEROIDS ARE THE
DRUG THAT CAN REVERSE THIS STATE.
VOLUME DEPLETION AND LOW CARDIAC OUTPUT LEADING TO CRITICALLY LOW BP ARE COMMON IN ACUTE
PITUITARY DEFICIENCY AND RECOVERY OF NORMAL CARDIOVASCULAR STATUS IS RAPIDLY ACHIEVED UNDER
HORMONE AND VOLUME REPLACEMENT THERAPY WITHOUT THE NEED FOR INOTROPES LIKE DOBUTAMINE.
PITUITARY APOPLEXY IS A HEMORRHAGIC INFARCTION OF LARGE PITUITARY ADENOMAS OR PITUITARY
INFARCTION DUE TO TRAUMATIC MAJOR BLOOD LOSS. IF THIS BLOOD LOSS OCCURS DURING DELIVERY, IT'S
CALLED SHEEHAN'S SYNDROME. THE HYPERPLASTIC ENLARGEMENT OF THE PITUITARY (SIZE OF GLAND INCREASES
BY ABOUT 125%), WHICH OCCURS NORMALLY DURING PREGNANCY, INCREASES THE RISK OF HEMORRHAGE AND
INFARCTION.
PITUITARY APOPLEXY PRESENTS ACUTELY AS AN ENDOCRINE EMERGENCY, WITH SUDDEN ONSET OF HEADACHE,
NAUSEA, VISUAL DEFICITS, PERSISTENT HYPOTENSION, TACHYCARDIA, AND HYPOGLYCEMIA LEADING TO SHOCK.
THE MOST PROMINENT SYMPTOMS ARE LACTATION FAILURE (DUE TO A DEFICIENCY OF
PROLACTIN) AND POSTPARTUM AMENORRHEA (DUE TO A DEFICIENCY OF GONADOTROPINS).
BECAUSE DEFICIENCIES OF SOME OR ALL PITUITARY-RESPONSIVE HORMONES MAY DEVELOP AFTER THE INITIAL
INSULT, SHEEHAN SYNDROME CAN BE HETEROGENEOUS AND NOT BE IDENTIFIED FOR YEARS. IT CAN PRESENT LATE
WITH THE FOLLOWING FEATURES LIKE LOSS OF PUBIC AND AXILLARY HAIR, HYPOTHYROIDISM DUE TO DECREASED
TSH SECRETION, ADRENAL INSUFFICIENCY DUE TO LOW ACTH.
TREATMENT IS BY HORMONE REPLACEMENT - FIRST GLUCOCORTICOIDS, LATER - THYROID HORMONE, SEX STEROIDS,
VASOPRESSIN, AND GROWTH HORMONES ARE GIVEN. IF THERE IS EVIDENCE OF PROGRESSIVE VISUAL LOSS, CRANIAL
NERVE INVOLVEMENT, OR LOSS OF CONSCIOUSNESS, IMMEDIATE SURGICAL DECOMPRESSION MUST BE CARRIED
OUT.

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt: WHICH OF THESE IS NOT TRUE WITH RESPECT TO LUPUS NEPHRITIS IN PREGNANCY?
options: IMMUNOSUPPRESSION CAN BE CONTINUED DURING PREGNANCY

PREGNANCY TO BE PLANNED ONCE THE DISEASE HAS BEEN QUIESCENT FOR AT LEAST 6 MONTHS AND THERE IS
NO EVIDENCE OF RENAL DYSFUNCTION
HIGH DOSE CORTICOSTEROIDS FOR LUPUS FLARE IN PREGNANCY IS SAFE
ECOSPIRIN, METHOTREXATE, CYCLOPHOSPHAMIDE, CORTICOSTEROIDS, AZATHIOPRINE ARE SAFE IN PREGNANCY
questions.answer: ECOSPIRIN, METHOTREXATE, CYCLOPHOSPHAMIDE, CORTICOSTEROIDS, AZATHIOPRINE ARE SAFE IN PREGNANCY
questions.explanation:
OPTION D IS NOT TRUE ABOUT LUPUS NEPHRITIS IN PREGNANCY. METHOTREXATE AND CYCLOPHOSPHAMIDE ARE
TERATOGENIC AND HENCE THEY ARE NOT SAFE DURING PREGNANCY.
SYSTEMIC LUPUS ERYTHEMATOSUS(SLE) IS A CHRONIC AUTOIMMUNE DISORDER INVOLVING THE MULTISYSTEM.
IT AFFECTS YOUNG WOMEN OF CHILDBEARING AGE. THE RENAL INVOLVEMENT OF THE DISEASE CAN MANIFEST IN
THE FORM OF ACTIVE LUPUS NEPHRITIS OR FLARE-UPS DURING PREGNANCY.
CLINICAL FEATURES INCLUDE FEVER, WEIGHT LOSS, MIGRATORY JOINT PAIN, AND MYALGIAS. IT CAN LEAD TO
PRETERM BIRTHS, PREECLAMPSIA, AND PREGNANCY LOSS WHILE THE INFANT CAN SUFFER FROM NEONATAL LUPUS
AND HEART BLOCK.
ANTINUCLEAR ANTIBODIES ARE USEFUL FOR SCREENING THE DISEASE. DOUBLE-STRANDED DNA (DS DNA) IS
HIGHLY SPECIFIC IN DIAGNOSING. OTHER ANTIBODIES SUCH AS LUPUS ANTICOAGULANT, ANTIPHOSPHOLIPID
ANTIBODIES, ANTI-RO, AND ANTI-LA ANTIBODIES ARE USEFUL IN DIAGNOSIS.
MANAGEMENT IS AS FOLLOWS
- PRECONCEPTIONAL PLANNING PLAYS AN IMPORTANT ROLE. CONCEPTION DURING A PERIOD OF QUIESCENCE FOR
AT LEAST 6 MONTHS DETERMINES A SUCCESSFUL OUTCOME. STABLE REMISSION OF RENAL DISEASE FOR AT LEAST 6
MONTHS BEFORE CONCEPTION IS RECOMMENDED.
- CORTICOSTEROIDS ARE USEFUL DURING EPISODES OF LUPUS FLARE AND CAN BE USED SAFELY IN PREGNANCY.
FOR PATIENTS ON CHRONIC CORTICOSTEROID THERAPY, INTRAVENOUS HYDROCORTISONE 100 MG, THREE DOSES
ARE GIVEN 8 HOURLY DURING LABOR OR AT THE TIME OF CESAREAN DELIVERY.
- IMMUNOSUPPRESSANTS SUCH AS AZATHIOPRINE CAN BE CONTINUED DURING PREGNANCY. IT MAY BE USED
IN CASE OF SEVERE SLE
- HYDROXYCHLOROQUINE IS FOUND TO BE THE BEST FOR MAINTENANCE AND IS SAFE IN PREGNANCY. IT CAN
PREVENT THE NEED FOR PROLONGED CORTICOSTEROID THERAPY.
6092

questions.subject: Obstetrics and Gynaecology
questions.prompt: WHICH OF THESE IS FALSE CONCERNING MANAGEMENT OF DIABETES IN PREGNANCY?
options: ELECTIVE C-SECTION HAS NO ROLE IN REDUCING INCIDENCE OF BRACHIAL PLEXUS INJURY

IN A PATIENT BEING PLANNED FOR INDUCTION OF LABOR, NIGHT DOSE OF INTERMEDIATE INSULIN IS GIVEN AS
PLANNED, AND THE MORNING DOSE IS WITHHELD
IN ACTIVE LABOR, IF RBS <70 MG%, D5 IS STARTED AT 100-150 ML/HR TILL THE RBS IS >100 MG%

CAPILLARY BLOOD GLUCOSE MONITORING LEVELS ARE KEPT AT FASTING- 95 MG%; 1 HR POSTPRANDIAL- 140
MG%; 2 HRS POSTPRANDIAL- 120 MG%
questions.answer: ELECTIVE C-SECTION HAS NO ROLE IN REDUCING INCIDENCE OF BRACHIAL PLEXUS INJURY
questions.explanation:
FALSE STATEMENT REGARDING MANAGEMENT OF DIABETES IN PREGNANCY IS OPTION A. CESAREAN SECTION IS
FOUND TO BE PROTECTIVE AGAINST TRAUMATIC INJURIES SUCH AS BRACHIAL PLEXUS INJURY, IN MACROSOMIC
BABIES BORN TO MOTHERS WITH DIABETES. AN ELECTIVE C-SECTION IS FOUND TO BE MORE PROTECTIVE THAN AN
EMERGENCY C-SECTION.
ALMOST 50 % OF PREGNANT WOMEN WITH DIABETES ARE DELIVERED BY C-SECTION. INDICATIONS FOR
C-SECTION IN DIABETIC PREGNANT WOMEN ARE-
- FETAL MACROSOMIA OF ≥4.5KGS TO AVOID TRAUMA TO MOTHER OR NEONATE, AND ALSO TO AVOID BRACHIAL
PLEXUS INJURY IN THE BABY
- UNSATISFACTORY PROGRESSION OF LABOR
- COMPLICATED DIABETES MELLITUS
- FETAL COMPROMISE DURING DELIVERY
- ELDERLY PRIMIGRAVIDA (AGE >30 YEARS)
- MULTIGRAVIDA WITH BAD OBSTETRIC HISTORY PREVIOUSLY
- PREGNANCY THAT IS ASSOCIATED WITH COMPLICATIONS LIKE PREECLAMPSIA, POLYHYDRAMNIOS OR
MALPRESENTATION
OTHER OPTIONS:
OPTION B: IN A PLANNED DELIVERY, ALTHOUGH THE BEDTIME DOSE OF INTERMEDIATE-ACTING INSULIN IS GIVEN,
IT IS RECOMMENDED THAT THE MORNING DOSE MUST BE WITHHELD. THIS IS DUE TO REDUCED INSULIN
REQUIREMENTS AFTER DELIVERY. THEREFORE, REGULAR INSULIN IS USED FOR GLYCEMIC CONTROL DURING THIS
TIME.
OPTION C: IN ACTIVE LABOR, IF RBS (RANDOM BLOOD GLUCOSE) <70 MG%, D5 (5% DEXTROSE) IS STARTED
AT 100-150 ML/HR TILL THE RBS IS >100 MG%. BEFORE INITIATION OF LABOR, NORMAL SALINE IS USED FOR
IV INFUSION.
OPTION D: SELF-MONITORING OF CAPILLARY BLOOD GLUCOSE IS ADVISED IN A PREGNANT WOMAN DIAGNOSED
WITH DIABETES. SUBCUTANEOUS CONTINUOUS GLUCOSE MONITORING DEVICES CAN ALSO BE USED FOR THE
SAME. THE GLUCOSE GOALS RECOMMENDED ARE:
- FASTING: ≤95 MG/DL
- 1 HOUR POST-PRANDIAL: ≤140 MG/DL
- 2 HRS POST-PRANDIAL: ≤120 MG/DL

questions.prompt: WHICH OF THESE STATEMENTS CONCERNING MGSO4 IS FALSE?

MGSO4 IS CONTINUED UPTO 24 HOURS AFTER DELIVERY OR LAST ATTACK OF SEIZURE
IT HAS INHIBITORY EFFECT ON CEREBRAL CORTEX THEREBY PREVENTING SEIZURES AND LOWERING THE BP

BASED ON RENAL FUNCTION
questions.answer: IT HAS INHIBITORY EFFECT ON CEREBRAL CORTEX THEREBY PREVENTING SEIZURES AND LOWERING THE BP
questions.explanation:
THE FALSE STATEMENT REGARDING MGSO4 (MAGNESIUM SULFATE) IS OPTION C. IT HAS AN INHIBITORY EFFECT
ON THE CEREBRAL CORTEX, THEREBY PREVENTING SEIZURES, BUT THIS ACTION IS NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR LOWERING
BLOOD PRESSURE.
6093
MGSO4 IS MAINLY USED IN PREECLAMPSIA DUE TO ITS SPECIFIC ANTICONVULSANT ACTION AND
NEUROPROTECTIVE ACTION ON THE CORTEX. MGSO4 ACTS AS A MEMBRANE STABILIZER. IT REDUCES MOTOR
ENDPLATE SENSITIVITY TO ACETYLCHOLINE AND BLOCKS NEURONAL CALCIUM INFLUX. IT IS NOT USED TO
TREAT HYPERTENSION, ALTHOUGH IT SHOWS SOME HYPOTENSIVE ACTION BY DECREASING VASCULAR RESPONSE TO
VASOPRESSORS.
MGSO4 IS USED FOR THE MANAGEMENT OF ECLAMPSIA AND AS PROPHYLAXIS IN SEVERE PRE-ECLAMPSIA. THE
THERAPEUTIC LEVEL OF MAGNESIUM IN ECLAMPSIA IS 4-7MEQ/L. THE TWO REGIMENS COMMONLY USED ARE
PRITCHARD AND SIBAI REGIMEN.
OTHER ACTIONS:
- CEREBRAL VASODILATATION
- UTERINE ARTERY VASODILATATION
- UTERINE TOCOLYTIC I.E. INHIBITS UTERINE CONTRACTILITY
- INCREASED PRODUCTION OF ENDOTHELIAL PROSTACYCLIN
- INHIBITS PLATELET ACTIVATION
OTHER OPTIONS:
OPTION A: MGSO4 INHIBITS UTERINE CONTRACTILITY BUT IS DOSE-DEPENDENT (ONLY ABOVE SERUM VALUES OF
8-10 MEQ/L).
OPTION B: MGSO4 HAS TO BE ADMINISTERED UP TO 24 HOURS AFTER THE LAST SEIZURE (IN POSTPARTUM
SEIZURE) OR DELIVERY, WHICHEVER IS LATER. FOR RECURRENT SEIZURES, 2 G IV BOLUS IS GIVEN IN THE ABOVE
REGIMEN.
OPTION D: MAGNESIUM IS CLEARED ALMOST EXCLUSIVELY BY RENAL EXCRETION. BUT, IN RENAL FAILURE, THE
INITIAL 4-G LOADING DOSE OF MAGNESIUM SULFATE CAN BE SAFELY ADMINISTERED REGARDLESS OF RENAL
FUNCTION. ONLY THE MAINTENANCE DOSE NEEDS TO BE ALTERED ACCORDING TO THE RENAL FUNCTION. THIS IS
BECAUSE THE LOADING DOSE IS RESPONSIBLE FOR REACHING THERAPEUTIC LEVELS, BUT THE MAINTENANCE DOSES
ARE RESPONSIBLE FOR MAINTAINING STEADY STATES.
